entries.title: 二十四节气粘土风格图标组
entries.description: 二十四节气完整图标组，以可爱3D粘土/充气风格呈现：每个节气一个圆角方形图标，内含代表…
entries.prompt: Complete set of all 24 Chinese solar terms (节气) as cute 3D clay-style app icons arranged in a 5-column grid on a light grey background. Each solar term has one rounded-corner square icon with a distinct nature symbol in 3D clay/inflatable style. The 24 icons in order: Start of Spring (tree with cloud), Rain Water (rain drops cloud), Awakening of Insects (cloud with thunder/insect), Spring Equinox (white daisy flowers), Clear and Bright (orange flower), Grain Rain (grain stalks with rain), Start of Summer (wheat stalks), Grain Buds (big yellow sun), Grain in Ear (red flower), Summer Solstice (wheat stalks), Minor Heat (white daisy flowers), Major Heat (orange autumn leaf), Start of Autumn (red tulip flower), End of Heat (orange pumpkin shape), White Dew (white cloud), Autumnal Equinox (red apple), Cold Dew (rain cloud), Frost (red maple leaf), Start of Winter (yellow daisy flowers), Minor Snow (white snowflake), Major Snow (white tree with snow), Winter Solstice (big snowflake), Minor Cold (light cloud), Major Cold (pink flower). Each icon: soft pastel background color, 3D clay tactile texture, rounded soft edges. Chinese name label centered below each icon in small clean sans-serif font. 5 icons per row, 5 rows, all icons same size and consistent style. 9:16 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 全套二十四节气可爱3D粘土风格App图标，排列在浅灰色背景的5列网格中。每个节气一个圆角方形图标，内含独特的自然符号，3D粘土/充气质感。24个图标依次为：立春（带云的树）、雨水（雨滴云朵）、惊蛰（雷云/虫子）、春分（白色雏菊花）、清明（橙色花朵）、谷雨（带雨的谷穗）、立夏（麦穗）、小满（大黄色太阳）、芒种（红色花）、夏至（麦穗）、小暑（白色雏菊）、大暑（橙色秋叶）、立秋（红色郁金香）、处暑（橙色南瓜形）、白露（白色云朵）、秋分（红苹果）、寒露（雨云）、霜降（红色枫叶）、立冬（黄色雏菊）、小雪（白色雪花）、大雪（带雪白色树）、冬至（大雪花）、小寒（淡色云）、大寒（粉色花）。每个图标：柔和马卡龙背景色，3D粘土触感，圆润柔软边缘。每个图标下方居中小号无衬线中文名称标签。5图标一行，5行，所有图标尺寸一致风格统一。竖版9:16。

entries.title: 紫藤花下屋顶猫咪插画
entries.description: 治愈系动漫风景插画：一只虎斑猫端坐于古旧中式屋顶瓦片上，仰头望向铺天盖地垂落的紫藤花瀑…
entries.prompt: Breathtaking healing anime landscape painting of a tabby cat sitting on an old Chinese traditional roof. The cat sits in a relaxed upright pose on grey curved ceramic roof tiles, looking upward with wide curious eyes. Above and around the cat: an overwhelming cascade of wisteria flowers in full bloom — hundreds of dense hanging clusters of soft purple-lavender blossoms and green leaves filling the entire upper three-quarters of the frame, like a ceiling of purple flowers. Wooden pergola beams and crossbars visible through the wisteria. Soft diffused spring light filters through the flower canopy creating beautiful dappled light spots and lens-like bokeh circles on the roof tiles. A few fallen purple petals scattered on the grey roof. Color palette: soft purple-lavender wisteria, fresh mint-sage green leaves, warm grey aged roof tiles, bright white sky glow in the background. Painterly brushstroke style combining watercolor and oil painting, loose expressive strokes especially on the flowers and leaves. Makoto Shinkai and Studio Ghibli-inspired atmosphere. 9:16 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 令人窒息的治愈系动漫风景插画：一只虎斑猫坐在古旧中式传统屋顶上。猫咪以放松的端坐姿势坐在灰色弧形陶瓷屋瓦上，睁着宽大好奇的眼睛向上仰望。猫咪上方和四周：满开的紫藤花倾泻而下——数百串密集垂落的柔和紫-薰衣草色花簇和绿叶充满画面上四分之三，如同紫色花朵天花板。木质凉亭横梁和格架从紫藤间隐约可见。柔和漫射的春日光线透过花冠筛落，在屋瓦上制造美丽的光斑和虚化光圈。几片脱落的紫色花瓣散落在灰色屋顶上。色调：柔和紫-薰衣草色紫藤，清新薄荷鼠尾草绿叶，温暖灰色老旧屋瓦，背景明亮白色天空光晕。笔触风格结合水彩与油画的绘画感，松散表现性笔触尤其体现在花朵和叶片上。新海诚与宫崎骏吉卜力工作室风格氛围。竖版9:16。

entries.title: 食谱手账步骤插画
entries.description: 可爱的螺旋装订手账食谱插画：温黄色网格笔记本纸张背景，顶部大标题采用可爱手写美食字体，…
entries.prompt: Adorable spiral-bound recipe notebook illustration in Japanese manga/anime hand-drawn style. Background: warm cream-yellow vintage grid notebook paper texture with spiral metal ring binding visible on the left edge and top edge. Layout has four illustrated recipe steps arranged on the page. TOP: Large decorative hand-lettered Chinese dish title in warm brown-orange bubble font with small cherry blossom flower doodles as decoration. STEP 1 box: cute watercolor-style illustration of fresh raw prawns with green scallions, ginger slices, garlic cloves, rock sugar crystals arranged nearby, hand-written ingredient list labels with quantities. STEP 2 box: small illustrations of dark soy sauce bottle, light soy sauce, cooking rice wine with hand-written labels. STEP 3 box: a wok/frying pan on a flame with glossy red-orange braised prawns sizzling in sauce, rising steam drawn as wispy lines. STEP 4 box: semi-photorealistic final plated dish of 6-8 beautiful braised whole prawns in rich sauce garnished with fresh scallion greens on a white plate. Decorative elements: small pressed flower and star stickers, doodle borders, warm yellow-amber color palette throughout. 9:16 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 可爱的螺旋装订食谱手账插画，日系漫画/动漫手绘风格。背景：温暖奶油黄色复古网格笔记本纸张纹理，左侧和顶端可见金属螺旋装订环。页面上排列四个图示食谱步骤。顶部：大型装饰性手写中文菜名，暖棕橙色泡泡字体，小樱花涂鸦点缀。步骤一方框：可爱水彩风格的新鲜生虾插画，旁边配有葱段、姜片、蒜头、冰糖晶体，手写食材标签配用量。步骤二方框：深色酱油瓶、生抽、料酒的小插画，配手写标签。步骤三方框：火焰上的炒锅/平底锅，红橙色光泽油焖大虾在酱汁中滋滋作响，缭绕蒸汽以飘散线条绘出。步骤四方框：半写实风格最终摆盘成品——6-8只完整美丽的油焖大虾淋上浓郁酱汁，白色盘子上撒新鲜葱花点缀。装饰元素：小型压花与星形贴纸、涂鸦边框、全篇温暖黄琥珀色调。竖版9:16。

entries.title: 城市名称3D景观字体设计
entries.description: 将中文城市名称的每个汉字变成立体三维景观字——字的笔画由微缩城市地标和自然景观构成：亭…
entries.prompt: Spectacular 3D Chinese character landscape typography art. The two characters for a Chinese city name are rendered as large-scale 3D sculptural forms, each character's strokes built from miniature city landmarks embedded within them. The brush strokes appear to be made of clay or thick paint, vibrant teal-blue color, with miniature 3D scenes growing from the strokes: classical stone arch bridges spanning the horizontal strokes, traditional Chinese pavilions and pagodas rising from the vertical strokes, weeping willow trees and blooming sakura/maple trees tucked into corners, lakes and rivers flowing through the curved strokes, traditional Chinese rooftop tiles visible on buildings. Bottom character has a multi-storied pagoda rising prominently from it, surrounded by a lake, stone lanterns, and autumn foliage in orange and red. Color palette: vibrant teal-cyan for the main strokes, red-orange pavilions, lush green trees, autumn orange and pink foliage. Pure white clean background. Small traditional red circular seal stamp (印章) in top right corner. Cinematic volumetric lighting. 9:16 vertical poster.
entries.promptZh: 震撼的三维中文城市名景观字体艺术。城市名称的每个汉字被渲染为大型三维雕塑形态，每个字的笔画由嵌入其中的城市地标微缩景观构成。笔画看起来由粘土或厚重颜料制成，鲜艳蓝绿色，微型三维场景从笔画中生长：经典石拱桥横跨横画，传统中国凉亭和宝塔从竖画中升起，垂柳和盛开的樱花/枫树嵌于笔画转折，湖泊和河流流淌于弧形笔画中，建筑上可见传统中式屋顶瓦片。下方汉字有多层宝塔从中突出，周围环绕湖泊、石灯笼、橙红秋色。色调：主笔画为鲜艳蓝绿色，红橙色亭台，翠绿树木，橙粉秋叶。纯白干净背景。右上角小型传统红色圆形印章。电影级体积光照。竖版9:16海报。

entries.title: 现代都市女性茶室人像
entries.description: 中西交融人像摄影：都市女性坐于仿古圈椅中，手捧透明茶杯，佩戴Apple Watch和有…
entries.prompt: Cinematic portrait of a modern Chinese woman in a traditional Chinese study-room setting. She sits relaxed in a classic rosewood circular armchair. Short wavy black hair, natural makeup, warm confident smile. Wearing an oversized brown wool sweater, Apple Watch on wrist, white wired earphones. Holding a glass tea cup with hot tea, visible steam rising. Background: classical Chinese wooden bookshelves lined with old books, decorative antiques, traditional lattice window with bamboo shadow outside. Warm golden amber cinematic light streaming from the window side. Color grade: warm browns, deep shadows, cozy afternoon mood. Shot on 85mm f/1.4, shallow depth of field. 9:16 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 电影感人像摄影：现代都市中国女性坐于传统中式书房。她悠然坐在经典红木圈椅上。短卷发，淡妆，温暖自信的笑容。身穿咖啡色宽松羊毛毛衣，手腕佩戴Apple Watch，白色有线耳机挂于耳边。双手捧着透明玻璃茶杯，热茶升腾白色烟雾。背景：古典中式博古架陈列旧书与古玩，传统中式格窗，窗外竹影婆娑。暖金色电影光线从窗侧洒入。色调：暖棕色调，深沉阴影，午后慵懒氛围。85mm f/1.4拍摄，浅景深。竖版9:16。

entries.title: 中国省份三维地形可视化地图
entries.description: 三维立体地形省份地图：真实山脉起伏的地形地貌，每个地级市用不同颜色区块划分，省界及沿海…
entries.prompt: Photorealistic 3D topographic relief map of a Chinese province. The terrain is raised and sculpted showing actual mountain ranges, plains, and coastline geography in physical 3D relief. Each prefecture-level city region is filled with a distinct solid color: rich jewel tones — deep purple, warm orange-red, teal green, olive gold, dark amber, dusty blue, coral pink, sage green, warm slate. The outer border of the entire province and major river boundaries glow with electric neon blue light, as if lit from below. White bold Chinese city name labels float above each region. The province floats on a dark charcoal grey stone-textured base map showing surrounding geography (sea, neighboring provinces in grey). Dramatic cinematic lighting from upper left creating strong shadows on the raised terrain. Slightly aerial bird's-eye view angle. Ultra-realistic CGI render quality. 1:1 square.
entries.promptZh: 中国省份超写实三维地形起伏地图。地形凸起雕刻，真实呈现山脉、平原和海岸线地理的三维立体效果。每个地级市行政区划以不同纯色填充：丰富的宝石色调——深紫、暖橙红、蓝绿、橄榄金、深琥珀、雾蓝、珊瑚粉、鼠尾草绿、暖石板灰。整个省份外缘及主要河流边界发出电蓝色霓虹光，如同从下方照亮。白色粗体中文城市名称标签悬浮于各区域上方。省份漂浮在深炭灰色石质纹理底图上，显示周边地理（大海、邻省以灰色呈现）。左上方戏剧性电影光照，在凸起地形上制造强烈阴影。轻微航拍俯视角度。超写实CGI渲染品质。方版1:1。

entries.title: 范曾风格水墨人物肖像
entries.description: 范曾大师风格的中国写意水墨人物：古代文人/武将半身像，自信的大笔触勾勒五官，极简色彩—…
entries.prompt: Chinese ink wash portrait in the style of master Fan Zeng (范曾). Half-body portrait of an ancient Chinese scholar literati. Confident bold brushwork defining facial features — sharp eyebrows, knowing expression, goatee. Very limited color palette: rich black ink for hair and details, cobalt blue wash for robes, vermilion-red accent on earlobes and lips. Vast white paper background as negative space. Traditional topknot hairstyle with headband. Ink robes loosely rendered with wet brush strokes — not tight or detailed. Artist red seal stamp (印章) and calligraphy signature lower right corner. The proud scholarly spirit of Tang and Song dynasty literati. 9:16 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 以范曾大师风格创作的中国写意水墨人物肖像。古代中国【文人/武将/侠客/士大夫】半身像。自信有力的大笔触勾勒面部特征——锋利眉毛、深邃眼神、山羊胡。极简色彩：浓黑墨描绘头发与细节，钴蓝色晕染衣袍，朱砂红点染耳垂与嘴唇。大面积白色纸张背景作为留白。传统发髻造型配头巾束发。衣袍以湿润笔触松散表现——不拘谨、不精细。右下角有红色印章与书法落款。唐宋文人士大夫的傲骨与儒雅气质。竖版 9:16。

entries.title: 中国古建筑爆炸结构图
entries.description: 中国古典建筑（故宫、天坛等）的爆炸分解结构图：中央为高精度3D等距渲染模型，屋顶/斗拱…
entries.prompt: Chinese imperial architecture exploded diagram infographic. Central subject: a Forbidden City main ceremonial hall (Taihedian) rendered as a highly detailed photorealistic isometric 3D model. Exploded view showing structural layers floating apart: glazed tile roof, elaborate dougong bracket clusters, red lacquer columns, painted ceiling medallion, marble terrace with balusters. White background. Technical blueprint drawings in corners: floor plan, elevation, cross-section. Chinese annotation lines with measurements pointing to architectural components. Gold, vermilion red, and deep teal color palette. JY DESIGN aesthetic — architecture education meets visual art. 9:16 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 中国皇家建筑爆炸分解图信息图。中心主体：【建筑类型，如故宫楼阁/天坛/宝塔】以高度精细的写实等距3D模型呈现。爆炸视图展示各结构层漂浮分离：琉璃瓦屋顶、精美斗拱组、朱红漆柱、彩绘藻井、汉白玉栏杆台基。白色背景。角落有技术蓝图：平面图、立面图、剖面图。带尺寸标注的中文引线指向各建筑构件。金色、朱红与深青的色调搭配。JY DESIGN美学——建筑教育与视觉艺术的融合。竖版 9:16。

entries.title: Quentin Blake 手绘卡通插画
entries.description: 模仿罗尔德·达尔御用插画师 Quentin Blake 的经典风格：奔放的钢笔线条、蜡…
entries.prompt: Create an illustration in the exact style of Quentin Blake, the beloved illustrator of Roald Dahl books. Loose, energetic ink line work with slightly scratchy pen strokes. Watercolor and crayon washes as fill — never perfectly within the lines. Two expressive cartoon characters interacting: a wild-haired absent-minded professor and a delighted gap-toothed child in a chaotic garden with books flying everywhere. Exaggerated facial expressions and gestural body language. Wildflowers, garden plants, or simple interior props as background. Off-white or cream paper background. Playful hand-lettered style title if text needed. The spontaneous, joyful energy of classic British children's book illustration. 9:16 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 以 Quentin Blake（罗尔德·达尔御用插画师）的经典风格创作插画。松散而充满活力的钢笔线条，略带抖动感的笔触。水彩与蜡笔填色，颜色不需要精准在线条内。两个表情夸张的卡通人物互动：【角色1】与【角色2】在【场景/背景】中。夸大的表情与肢体语言充满表现力。背景用野花、花园植物或简单室内道具。米白色或奶油色纸张背景。如有文字则使用手写感的俏皮字体。捕捉经典英国童书插画那种自发的、欢乐的生命力。竖版 9:16。

entries.title: 汉服时尚编辑大片
entries.description: 汉服时尚编辑大片，古代华服在自然山水间飘逸，传统服饰美学的当代时尚重新演绎。
entries.prompt: Create a beautiful hanfu traditional Chinese clothing fashion editorial. Model in flowing silk hanfu — Wei or Tang dynasty style — in natural setting: bamboo grove, lotus pond, or ancient architecture. Fabric movement in wind. Natural light. Cultural poetry combined with fashion photography. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作美丽的汉服中国传统服饰时尚编辑大片。模特穿着飘逸丝绸汉服——魏或唐朝风格——在自然场景中：竹林、荷花池或古建筑。面料在风中飘动。自然光线。文化诗意与时装摄影的结合。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 传统服饰民族人像
entries.description: 传统民族服饰人像，精美刺绣与配饰记录文化的精华，人文与美学兼备的视觉档案。
entries.prompt: Create a dignified traditional costume portrait of Miao ethnic minority of Guizhou — elaborate silver headdress and embroidered costume. Subject wearing authentic traditional garments with intricate embroidery, jewelry, and headdress. Natural light or softbox that honors the textile details. Respectful documentary photography. Rich textile texture visible. Cultural heritage documentation quality. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作【[民族/文化]】庄重的传统服饰人像。人物穿着真实的传统服装，配有精美刺绣、珠宝与头饰。尊重纺织细节的自然光或柔光箱。尊重文化的纪录式摄影。丰富织物质感可见。文化遗产记录品质。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 浮世绘现代融合插画
entries.description: 浮世绘与现代元素的视觉融合，传统木版印刷风格描绘当代都市场景，古今对话。
entries.prompt: Create a Ukiyo-e style woodblock print illustration fusing traditional with modern: classic Hokusai or Hiroshige style but depicting a vintage red Ferrari 250 GTO racing through rain. Hand-carved woodblock print texture. Limited palette with flat areas. Bold black outlines. Diagonal rain or wave pattern. Poetic fusion of eras. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作浮世绘风格木版印刷插画，融合传统与现代：经典北斋或广重风格，但描绘【[现代主题——东京天际线、跑车、宇航员]】。手雕木版印刷质感。有限色板与平面色块区域。粗犷黑色轮廓线。斜线雨或波浪纹样。跨越时代的诗意融合。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 史诗龙骑士动漫
entries.description: 史诗龙骑士动漫大片，骑士与神龙翱翔于云层之上，壮阔天空与神话级别的视觉震撼。
entries.prompt: Create an epic dragon rider anime illustration. A heroic anime warrior riding a magnificent dragon soaring above dramatic cloud formations. The dragon has detailed scales and powerful wings spread wide. Blazing sunset or dramatic stormy sky background. Motion and speed implied by cloud streaks. Epic fantasy anime movie poster quality — inspired by Dragon Ball, Made in Abyss level of artistic detail. Cinematic widescreen 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 创作一张史诗龙骑士动漫插画。英雄动漫战士骑乘壮观神龙翱翔于戏剧性云层之上。神龙拥有细节满满的鳞片和大力展开的巨翼。背景是燃烧般落日或戏剧性风暴天空。云迹暗示运动与速度。史诗奇幻动漫电影海报品质——受七龙珠、来自深渊的艺术细节水准启发。电影感宽银幕 16:9。

entries.title: 樱花小巷
entries.description: 日本樱花小巷，粉色花瓣漫天飞舞，古老石板路通向诗意的远方，春天最美的邀请。
entries.prompt: Create a breathtaking cherry blossom alley photograph in Japan. A narrow stone-paved path flanked by ancient cherry trees in full bloom — thick overarching branches creating a pink floral tunnel. Fallen petals covering the ground and floating in the air. Soft spring morning light filtering through blossoms. Possibly a traditional gate or lantern in background. Film photography aesthetic with Kodak Portra colors. Ratio 4:5.
entries.promptZh: 拍摄一张日本令人叹息的樱花小巷照片。狭窄石板路两侧是盛开的古老樱树，茂密的樱花枝条拱成粉色花隧道。凋落花瓣铺满地面并飘浮在空气中。柔和的春日晨光从花丛中过滤而下。背景可见传统门廊或灯笼。胶片摄影美学，Kodak Portra 色调。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 三维卡通角色

entries.title: 柯达 Portra 杂志风人像
entries.description: Kodak Portra 400 胶片的招牌调色——奶白高光、提亮暗部、肤色精准还原、…
entries.prompt:
Create a fashion editorial portrait of a young East Asian woman with natural wavy hair shot on Kodak Portra 400 film. Location: golden hour rooftop with city skyline. The model is styled in relaxed chic.

Film characteristics: Portra 400's signature milky highlights with slight halation, lifted shadows revealing shadow detail, accurate warm skin tone reproduction, gentle grain structure visible at 100%. Greens are slightly desaturated shifting toward olive. Blues remain cool and crisp.

Lighting: available natural light as primary source, possibly supplemented with white reflector for fill. The light should feel effortless and unmanipulated. Lens: 85mm portrait equivalent, f/2 shallow depth of field, buttery background bokeh. Slightly underexposed ⅓ stop for richer tones.

Mood: sophisticated, unhurried, the photograph feels found rather than made. Slight organic imperfection—a small breath blur, the model mid-blink or mid-laugh. Magazine quality but with soul. Ratio 2:3.
entries.promptZh:
创作一幅在柯达Portra 400胶片上拍摄的【[主角]】时尚编辑人像。地点：【[场景：黄金时刻屋顶/自然窗光摄影棚/地中海街道]】。模特造型为【[风格：休闲优雅/编辑先锋]】。

胶片特性：Portra 400标志性的奶白高光带轻微光晕，提亮暗部展现细节，精准的暖肤色还原，100%放大时可见柔和颗粒结构。绿色略微去饱和向橄榄色偏移。蓝色保持冷峻清晰。

光效：可用自然光作为主光源，可能以白色反光板补光。光线应感觉毫不费力和未经处理。镜头：85mm等效焦段，f/2浅景深，黄油般的背景虚化。轻微欠曝⅓档以获得更丰富的色调。

氛围：精致、从容，照片感觉是被发现而非被制作。轻微有机不完美——轻微的呼吸模糊，模特半眨眼或大笑中。杂志品质但有灵魂。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 奢华护肤品广告大片
entries.description: 高端护肤品广告的极致美学——黑暗背景、戏剧光影、液体飞溅与产品的完美邂逅。
entries.prompt:
Create a cinematic luxury skincare product advertisement for LUMIÈRE Sérum Éclat. Dark studio background fading to absolute black. The product—an elegant glass bottle or jar—sits as the primary hero, lit with dramatic single-source lighting that creates sharp specular highlights and deep, rich shadows.

Surround the product with a dynamic frozen-moment splash: translucent serum or water erupting upward, droplets suspended mid-air, catching the light as perfect spheres. Floating botanical elements—white orchid petals, gold leaf fragments, or fresh herb sprigs—orbit the scene at varying distances.

Texture emphasis: cold glass clarity, liquid surface tension, velvet matte packaging. Color palette: deep charcoal black, warm champagne gold, pure white light. One accent color from the brand (rose, jade, or midnight blue). Photorealistic commercial photography quality, 4K. Ratio 4:5.
entries.promptZh:
为【[产品名称]】创作一幅电影级奢华护肤品广告。暗色摄影棚背景渐变至纯黑。产品——一个优雅的玻璃瓶或罐——作为主角，以戏剧性的单光源照明，产生锐利的高光和深沉丰富的阴影。

用动态凝固瞬间包围产品：半透明精华液或水向上迸发，水珠悬停在空中，捕捉光线如完美球体。飘浮的植物元素——白色兰花花瓣、金箔碎片或新鲜香草嫩芽——在不同距离环绕场景。

质感重点：冰冷玻璃的清澈感、液体表面张力、哑光天鹅绒包装。色彩：深炭灰黑、暖香槟金、纯白光。加入一个品牌强调色（玫瑰、翡翠绿或午夜蓝）。摄影级真实感商业大片，4K。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 怀旧胶片拼贴摄影
entries.description: 70-80年代复古胶片美学，多张叠加的旧照片、手写文字、邮票和胶带，构成有故事感的拼贴…
entries.prompt:
Create a retro film collage photograph featuring a young woman wandering through 1970s Tokyo. Layer multiple vintage photographs of different sizes, angles, and ages—some faded, some over-exposed, some with light leaks and film grain. The main subject should emerge from this layered composition.

Intersperse physical ephemera: Polaroid frames, yellowed newspaper clippings, airmail envelopes, dried flowers pressed flat, vintage stamps, old ticket stubs, washi tape strips in muted earth tones. Add handwritten annotations in pencil and faded blue ink—dates, captions, fragments of poetry.

Color grade: Kodak Portra 400 warmth—milky highlights, lifted blacks, soft grain, desaturated greens pushing toward olive. Slight vignette at corners. The overall mood evokes memory, nostalgia, and the material weight of preserved moments. Aspect ratio 3:4.
entries.promptZh:
创作一幅以【[主题]】为核心的复古胶片拼贴摄影作品。叠加多张不同尺寸、角度和年代的老照片——有些褪色、有些过曝、有些带有漏光和胶片颗粒。主体从这种层叠构图中浮现。

穿插实物纸制品：宝丽来相框、泛黄的报纸剪报、航空邮件信封、压平的干花、复古邮票、旧车票票根、和纸胶带（土地色调）。用铅笔和褪色蓝墨水添加手写注释——日期、说明文字、诗歌片段。

色彩调色：柯达Portra 400的温暖感——奶白高光、提亮的暗部、柔和颗粒、去饱和的绿色推向橄榄色。角落轻微暗角。整体氛围唤起记忆、怀旧和珍藏瞬间的物质重量。比例 3:4。

entries.title: 极简线描女孩与红花插画

entries.prompt: Extremely minimalist fine line art illustration, a young woman shown in full-body side silhouette profile, hair pulled back into a loose low bun with wispy strands, a calm serene expression, wearing a long flowing high-neck dress with long sleeves, the dress fabric rendered in loose flowing pen lines suggesting movement in a breeze, delicate flat sandals. She holds a single stem of blooming red poppy flowers with several open blossoms and buds down at her side, rendered in vivid red and green watercolor coloring as the only colored elements in the entire illustration. The rest of the figure and dress are pure black fine-line pen drawing on a completely blank white background with no other elements. Extremely elegant negative space composition, delicate confident linework, minimalist fashion illustration aesthetic, 1:2 tall vertical
entries.promptZh: 极其简约的精细线描插画，一位年轻女性以全身侧面剪影呈现，头发向后梳成松散的低丸子头带碎发丝，表情宁静平和，身穿飘逸的高领长袖长裙，裙摆面料以松散流动的钢笔线条表现随风飘动感，精致的平底凉鞋。她手持一枝盛开的红色罂粟花垂在身侧，几朵盛开花朵和花苞，以鲜艳的红绿水彩上色作为整幅插画中唯一的彩色元素。人物其余部分和裙装均为纯黑色钢笔线描，背景是完全空白的白色，没有其他元素。极其优雅的留白构图，精致自信的线条表现，极简时尚插画美学，1:2瘦长竖版

entries.title: 日系大妈角色表情包贴纸组
entries.description: 十二宫格卡通大妈表情贴纸，烫染卷发豹纹装扮夸张演绎日常情绪，每格配日文流行语大字气泡，…
entries.prompt: Cheerful cartoon sticker pack illustration, a 3×4 grid of twelve individual stickers all featuring the same recurring character: a middle-aged Japanese woman with a permed curly brown updo hairstyle, round glasses (in some panels), wearing a leopard-print cardigan and colorful floral outfits, exaggerated comedic facial expressions and body language in each panel matching a different everyday emotion or situation. Each sticker shows the character in a distinct pose: giving an enthusiastic thumbs up, panicking dramatically over a boiling pot on the stove, cheering with a fist pump, doing a confident thumbs up while holding a notebook, waving cheerfully while shopping, jogging energetically in a tracksuit, sitting exhausted looking sad, fanning herself dramatically looking overheated, gesturing gracefully with a flowing motion, sipping tea contentedly from a teapot, pointing firmly at a moving box, clasping hands together with a delighted sparkly expression. Each sticker has a large bold colorful Japanese text word or phrase in a speech-bubble-adjacent comic font positioned above or beside the character matching her expression (like "well done", "oh no", "here we go", "nice", "next", "one more round", "it's over", "too hot", "good flow", "reset", "put it there", "wonderful"), each text outlined with a thick white border for sticker readability. Clean white background behind each character, vibrant flat cartoon coloring, thick black outline character design, LINE messaging app sticker pack aesthetic, 4:5 vertical
entries.promptZh: 欢快的卡通表情贴纸包插画，3×4网格排列十二张独立贴纸，全部以同一位反复出现的角色为主角：一位中年日本女性，烫染卷曲棕色盘发，圆框眼镜（部分格子出现），身穿豹纹开衫和缤纷花色服装，每格都用夸张的喜剧化面部表情和肢体语言演绎不同的日常情绪或场景。每张贴纸展示角色不同姿态：热情竖大拇指、对着炉灶上沸腾的锅戏剧性地惊慌、握拳欢呼庆祝、拿着笔记本自信竖大拇指、开心挥手购物、穿运动服精神抖擞地慢跑、疲惫地坐着显得难过、戏剧性地扇风显得燥热、优雅地做流动手势、心满意足地喝茶、坚定地指向一个移动纸箱、双手合十露出闪亮的欣喜表情。每张贴纸都配一个大号粗体彩色日文单词或短语，以类似对话框的漫画字体排布在角色上方或旁边，与她的表情相配（如"做得好"、"糟糕"、"来吧"、"真棒"、"下一个"、"再来一轮"、"结束了"、"太热了"、"节奏不错"、"重置"、"放这里"、"太棒了"），每段文字都描边加粗白色边框以便贴纸辨识。每个角色背后是干净的白色背景，鲜艳的扁平卡通上色，粗黑色轮廓角色设计，LINE聊天软件贴纸包美学，4:5竖版

entries.title: 巴黎街头OOTD拍立得穿搭标注
entries.description: 巴黎街头咖啡桌上放着一张拍立得照片，照片中女生穿驼色高领毛衣配短裙长靴俏皮跳跃，白色手…
entries.prompt: Creative OOTD fashion photograph with a photo-within-photo concept. A round wooden outdoor cafe table with scattered golden autumn maple leaves and a ceramic cup of coffee on a saucer, set on a Parisian sidewalk with a blurred cafe storefront and street visible in the background. Resting on the table is a large polaroid-style instant photograph with a white border, and within that polaroid photograph, a three-dimensional effect makes it appear as if a young woman is physically emerging out of the photograph into the real world: her head, torso, and upper body extend above the polaroid's surface in full photorealistic 3D form, wearing a beige ribbed turtleneck sweater and matching beige mini skirt, while her legs in tall brown leather knee-high boots remain flat within the 2D polaroid image below, creating a playful dimensional break effect. She leans forward with a playful pouty expression, one hand reaching toward the camera. White handwritten-style annotation text with thin arrows point to her boots labeled "leather boots", her skirt labeled "mini skirt", and her sweater labeled "clean turtleneck". Small text at the bottom of the polaroid reads "OOTD ESCAPE - PARIS". Warm autumn afternoon lighting, realistic street photography aesthetic merged with creative dimensional photo-manipulation, 4:5 vertical
entries.promptZh: 创意的OOTD穿搭摄影，照片中有照片的概念设计。一张圆形木质户外咖啡桌，散落着金黄色秋季枫叶和一杯配茶碟的陶瓷咖啡，置于巴黎人行道上，背景是虚化的咖啡馆橱窗和街道。桌上放着一张带白边的大号拍立得风格即时照片，照片内运用立体效果，让人感觉一位年轻女性正从照片中实际探出身体进入现实世界：她的头部、躯干和上半身以完整的照片级3D形态延伸到拍立得表面之上，穿着米色罗纹高领毛衣配同色系米色迷你裙，而她穿着高筒棕色皮质及膝靴的双腿则仍平面呈现在下方2D拍立得图像内，营造俏皮的维度突破效果。她身体前倾露出俏皮的嘟嘴表情，一手伸向镜头。白色手写风格标注文字配细箭头指向她的靴子标注"leather boots"，裙子标注"mini skirt"，毛衣标注"clean turtleneck"。拍立得底部小字写着"OOTD ESCAPE - PARIS"。温暖的秋日午后光线，写实街拍摄影美学融合创意维度照片合成，4:5竖版

entries.title: 复古乡村校园操场纪实摄影
entries.description: 八九十年代红砖平房教室外的乡村小学操场，孩子们蓝布校服嬉戏打闹，篮球架黑板报与标语墙唤…
entries.prompt: Nostalgic documentary-style photograph of a rural Chinese elementary school courtyard from the 1980s-1990s era. A long red-brick single-story school building with a grey tiled roof and multiple wood-framed windows, faded red painted Chinese slogan characters on the brick wall reading an encouraging educational phrase, a small blackboard mounted outside one classroom door showing simple handwritten arithmetic. A weathered basketball hoop with a worn wooden backboard and a metal rim with an old net stands in the dirt courtyard, a loudspeaker mounted on a wooden pole nearby. Several children in matching worn blue denim-style school uniforms with canvas satchel bags play and walk around the dusty courtyard in various small groups, some sitting on a low wall, some walking with backpacks, captured in candid unposed documentary moments. Bare young trees with sparse leaves planted in a row, tall trees with green foliage in the background. Warm hazy golden-hour sunlight, soft warm color grading with slight film grain texture reminiscent of vintage Kodak film photography, nostalgic collective memory mood, authentic 1990s Chinese rural school aesthetic, 9:16 vertical
entries.promptZh: 怀旧纪实风格摄影，展现1980-1990年代中国乡村小学操场。一栋长长的红砖平房教室，灰色瓦顶配多扇木框窗户，砖墙上褪色的红漆中文标语写着励志教育短语，一间教室门外挂着小黑板，上面是简单的手写算术题。泥土操场上立着一个风化的篮球架，木质篮板已磨损，铁圈上挂着旧网，附近木杆上装着一个广播喇叭。几个孩子穿着统一的做旧蓝色牛仔布校服，背着帆布书包，三三两两地在尘土操场上玩耍走动，有的坐在矮墙上，有的背着书包行走，捕捉到自然随性的纪实瞬间。稀疏树叶的光秃小树成排种植，背景是枝叶茂盛的高大树木。温暖朦胧的黄金时刻阳光，柔和暖色调配轻微胶片颗粒质感，怀旧的集体记忆氛围，真实的1990年代中国乡村校园美学，9:16竖版

entries.title: 明星时尚杂志封面拼贴图
entries.description: 同一位女明星身着米色针织衫牛仔裙的九宫格杂志封面拼贴，Vogue、Bazaar、ELL…
entries.prompt: Fan-made celebrity magazine cover collage poster, a 3×3 grid layout with the center panel larger than the surrounding eight panels. Center: a full-body photograph of a young Asian female celebrity with long straight black hair, standing confidently, wearing an oversized cream cable-knit sweater tucked loosely into a light-wash denim mini skirt, white knee-high socks, white sneakers, one hand in pocket. Surrounding panels each show a different cropped photograph of the same woman (close-up of her eyes, laughing candidly, side profile portrait, sitting on a wooden stool, hands framing her face smiling, three-quarter body shot) styled as different fashion magazine covers, each panel bearing a different famous magazine masthead logo in the top area (Vogue, Elle, Harper's Bazaar, Marie Claire, i-D) rendered in each magazine's signature typography style, with small mock article headline text scattered around each cover mimicking real magazine cover text placement, a small barcode graphic in one bottom corner. Neutral cream and beige color palette throughout matching her outfit, high-fashion editorial photography quality, glossy magazine cover aesthetic, 4:5 vertical
entries.promptZh: 粉丝制作风格的明星杂志封面拼贴海报，3×3网格排版，中央格子比周围八格更大。中央：一位长直黑发的年轻亚裔女明星全身照，自信站立，穿oversize奶油色绞花针织毛衣松垮地塞进浅色水洗牛仔迷你裙，白色及膝袜，白色运动鞋，一手插兜。周围格子各展示同一女性的不同裁切照片（眼部特写、率真大笑、侧脸肖像、坐在木凳上、双手托脸微笑、四分之三身照），呈现为不同的时尚杂志封面样式，每格顶部区域带有不同的知名杂志刊头logo（Vogue、Elle、Harper's Bazaar、Marie Claire、i-D），以各杂志标志性字体风格呈现，每个封面周围散布着模拟真实杂志封面排版的小号仿文章标题文字，一个底角配小号条形码图形。整体呈现与她服装相配的中性奶油米色调，高级时尚编辑摄影品质，光泽感杂志封面美学，4:5竖版

entries.title: 米兰卡通贴纸旅行拼贴图
entries.description: 真人游客背影站在米兰大教堂前，周围环绕同一角色的卡通Q版贴纸重现拍照、骑摩托、吃披萨吃…
entries.prompt: Playful travel memory collage photograph, a real photograph of a young woman with long curly brown hair, black crop top and wide-leg jeans, standing with her back to the camera looking up at the grand Gothic facade of Milan Cathedral (Duomo di Milano) with its intricate spires and statues, warm overcast daylight. Surrounding this central real photograph, scattered around the composition, are seven small chibi-style cartoon sticker illustrations of the same curly-haired woman character in different cute poses relating to travel activities: waving an Italian flag excitedly, taking a photo with a camera, sitting at a cafe table with coffee and a croissant, riding a small green scooter, eating a large ice cream cone joyfully, reading a paper map looking adorably lost, sitting cross-legged eating a slice of pizza happily. Each chibi sticker has a thin white sticker border. Scattered hand-drawn doodle elements throughout: small pink hearts, sparkle stars, dashed motion lines. Handwritten casual script text captions near each sticker in white and pink (Ciao Milano, Milan you stole my heart, capturing beautiful memories, coffee and dreams, gelato makes everything better, la dolce vita, getting lost in the best way, pizza is always a good idea, grazie milano, not a dream just italy). entries.prompt: Create a high-end cosmetics brand campaign visual for Charlotte Tilbury Pillow Talk lip collection. Hero product integrated with beautiful model portrait. Soft studio lighting with skin-flattering quality. Brand color palette woven throughout. Product floating or held elegantly. Chanel Beauty, NARS, or Charlotte Tilbury campaign quality. 4:5.
entries.promptZh: 为【[品牌]】创作高端美妆品牌视觉活动。主打产品与美丽模特人像融合。柔和工作室灯光，令肌肤更美。品牌色板贯穿始终。产品优雅漂浮或握持。香奈儿美妆、NARS或夏洛特·蒂尔伯里广告品质。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 播客品牌视觉形象
entries.description: 播客品牌视觉体系，从封面到社交媒体模板的完整设计，让声音节目在视觉上同样抢眼。
entries.prompt: Create a podcast brand visual identity for DEEP FOCUS — a podcast about flow states and creativity. Album artwork for the podcast cover — bold typography, distinctive illustration or photography. Applied to: Spotify player mockup, social media story template, website header. Audio waveform design element. Modern digital media aesthetic. 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 为【[播客名称/主题]】创作播客品牌视觉形象。播客封面图——大胆字体、独特插画或摄影。应用于：Spotify播放器样机、社交媒体故事模板、网站标题。音频波形设计元素。现代数字媒体美学。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 奢华酒店品牌形象
entries.description: 奢华酒店品牌视觉形象，从门牌到信头纸的完整品牌应用，传递顶级酒店的尊贵气质。
entries.prompt: Create a luxury hotel brand identity showcase for THE OBSIDIAN — a luxury mountain retreat. Refined logotype with custom letterform. Applied to: key card, welcome letter, pillow chocolate wrapper, room number plate, tote bag. Elegant minimal aesthetic. Cream, navy, and gold palette. Four Seasons or Aman resort quality. 4:3.
entries.promptZh: 为【[酒店名称]】创作奢华酒店品牌形象展示。精致的字标，定制字形设计。应用于：房卡、欢迎信、枕头巧克力包装、房间号牌、手提袋。优雅极简美学。奶油、海军蓝与金色色板。四季酒店或安缦度假村品质。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 抽象色域三维
entries.description: 抽象色域三维视觉，大面积纯色曲面在空间中漂浮交叠，色彩即内容的极致三维表达。
entries.prompt: Create an abstract color field 3D composition. Large curved planes of pure saturated color floating and intersecting in space. No texture — pure smooth matte surface. Colors: vibrant but harmonious palette of 3-4 hues. Soft ambient lighting. Rothko-inspired color field meets 3D sculpture. 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 创作抽象色域三维构图。大型纯饱和色彩曲面在空间中漂浮交叉。无质感——纯光滑哑光表面。色彩：3-4色相的鲜艳而和谐色板。柔和环境光。罗斯科风格色域遇见三维雕塑。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 奇幻生物三维设计
entries.description: 奇幻生物三维概念设计，鳞片、羽翼与发光眼睛的每个细节都令人信服，数字神话的造物主。
entries.prompt: Create a photorealistic fantasy creature 3D design concept for a crystal-armored deep-sea dragon with bioluminescent fins. Detailed scales, feathers, or fur with subsurface scattering skin. Glowing magical eyes. Dramatic environment lighting. Every anatomical detail convincing and believable. Film VFX quality — Avatar or Lord of the Rings creature work. 4:5.
entries.promptZh: 为【[生物类型]】创作超写实奇幻生物三维设计概念。详细的鳞片、羽毛或皮毛，带有次表面散射皮肤。发光魔法眼睛。戏剧性环境光线。每个解剖细节令人信服。电影VFX品质——阿凡达或指环王的生物创作水准。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 科幻飞船三维设计
entries.description: 科幻飞船外观三维设计概念，精密的机械细节与星际航行的宏大想象，工业设计与科幻美学融合。
entries.prompt: Create a photorealistic sci-fi spaceship exterior 3D concept design. Detailed hull plating, engine nacelles, weapons systems, and running lights. Deep space background with nebula. Dramatic light from a nearby star. Industrial and functional yet visually awe-inspiring design. Interstellar or Halo aesthetic. 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 创作超写实科幻飞船外观三维概念设计。详细的船体装甲板、引擎舱、武器系统与导航灯。深空背景搭配星云。附近恒星的戏剧性光线。工业功能性却视觉上令人敬畏的设计。星际穿越或光晕美学。比例 16:9。

entries.title: 建筑可视化三维
entries.description: 现代建筑效果图，精确的日光模拟与人文活动，让未建成的建筑在图像中已获生命。
entries.prompt: Create a photorealistic architectural visualization for a luxury glass-and-concrete villa cantilevered over an ocean cliff. Modern minimalist structure with floor-to-ceiling glass, clean concrete and wood. Golden hour sunlight casting long shadows. Human figures for scale. Lush landscaping. The quality of Bjarke Ingels Group or Kengo Kuma architectural rendering. 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 为【[建筑类型]】创作超写实建筑可视化。现代极简主义建筑，落地玻璃幕墙，干净混凝土与木材。黄金时段阳光投下长影。人物比例参照物。茂密景观绿化。比雅克·英格尔斯事务所或隈研吾建筑渲染品质。比例 16:9。

entries.title: 猎魔人动漫人像
entries.description: 猎魔人动漫人像，身背特殊武器的战士在满月夜独立，黑暗奇幻动漫的英雄美学。
entries.prompt: Create a demon hunter anime portrait. A lone hunter — specialized weapon on back — standing on a rooftop against a full moon night sky. Cape flowing in wind. Battle-worn armor with magical inscriptions. City or village below. Kimetsu no Yaiba or Claymore dark fantasy hero aesthetic. 9:16.
entries.promptZh: 创作猎魔人动漫人像。孤独的猎人——背负特殊武器——站在屋顶对抗满月夜空。斗篷在风中飘扬。带有魔法铭文的战损盔甲。下方是城市或村庄。鬼灭之刃或古语的黑暗奇幻英雄美学。比例 9:16。

entries.title: 妖狐精灵动漫
entries.description: 九尾妖狐动漫插画，多尾白狐在林间跳跃，水墨笔触与动漫彩绘的融合，东方灵异之美。
entries.prompt: Create a spirit fox (kitsune) anime illustration with ink wash elements. Nine-tailed fox spirit — elegant white fox with multiple magical tails — in a bamboo forest or shrine setting. Ink brush strokes for environmental details. Glowing blue-white fox fire (kitsune-bi). Ethereal and mysterious Eastern spirit. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作带有水墨元素的妖狐（狐狸精）动漫插画。九尾狐灵——优雅白狐有多条魔法尾巴——在竹林或神社场景中。环境细节以水墨笔触表现。发光蓝白狐火（狐狸火）。空灵神秘的东方灵异之美。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 水下人鱼动漫
entries.description: 水下人鱼动漫插画，鱼尾在海底珊瑚间翩翩起舞，梦幻水色与发光生物共同编织深海童话。
entries.prompt: Create a beautiful underwater mermaid anime illustration. Graceful mermaid with iridescent tail swimming among colorful coral and tropical fish. Rays of sunlight filtering down from surface. Bioluminescent sea creatures. Deep teal and aquamarine water tones. Magical and serene ocean world. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作美丽的水下人鱼动漫插画。优雅的人鱼，彩虹色鱼尾在五彩珊瑚与热带鱼间游泳。阳光从水面向下筛落。生物发光海洋生物。深青绿色水调。神奇而宁静的海洋世界。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 异世界传送门动漫
entries.description: 异世界传送动漫经典场景，蓝白光芒的传送门将现代少年送入奇幻王国，命运的转折点。
entries.prompt: Create an isekai fantasy portal anime illustration. A modern Japanese teenager standing before a glowing magical portal — blue-white swirling energy gate. On one side: modern Japan; on the other side: glimpse of fantasy kingdom with dragons and castles. Epic lighting from the portal. Dramatic moment of crossing fates. 9:16.
entries.promptZh: 创作异世界奇幻传送门动漫插画。现代日本少年站在发光魔法传送门前——蓝白旋转能量之门。一侧是现代日本；另一侧是奇幻王国的一瞥，有龙与城堡。传送门发出史诗性光芒。跨越命运的戏剧性时刻。比例 9:16。

entries.title: 日常校园动漫
entries.description: 温馨日常校园动漫场景，阳光教室与青春笑颜，治愈系动漫最熟悉的生命片段。
entries.prompt: Create a warm slice-of-life school anime illustration. High school classroom scene with afternoon light streaming through windows, dust motes floating. Anime students chatting or studying, cherry blossoms visible outside. Warm golden light and soft colors. K-On, Clannad, Toradora visual warmth. 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 创作温馨的日常校园动漫插画。下午阳光从窗户斜射进教室，光尘微粒漂浮。动漫学生聊天或学习，窗外可见樱花。温暖金色光与柔和色彩。轻音部、CLANNAD、龙虎斗视觉温暖感。比例 16:9。

entries.title: 原宿街头时尚
entries.description: 原宿青年街头时尚，夸张多彩的个性造型与竹下通为背景，日本次文化的视觉狂欢。
entries.prompt: Create a vibrant Harajuku street fashion portrait. Young Japanese person in elaborate Harajuku fashion — Lolita, Decora, or street kei style — standing in Takeshita Street. Bold colors, layered accessories, dramatic makeup. Surrounding colorful shops. Authentic Tokyo youth culture energy. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作充满活力的原宿街头时尚人像。年轻日本人穿着精心设计的原宿时尚——洛丽塔、Decora或街道系风格——站在竹下通。大胆色彩、叠层配饰、戏剧性妆容。周围彩色店铺。真实的东京青年文化能量。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 东京涩谷十字路口
entries.description: 东京涩谷十字路口，数百人同时穿越，长曝光的人流轨迹与霓虹广告牌，城市脉搏的视觉史诗。
entries.prompt: Create a cinematic photograph of Shibuya Crossing in Tokyo at night. Hundreds of pedestrians crossing from all directions simultaneously. Long exposure light trails from people and vehicles. Giant LED billboards lighting the scene in blue and white. Overhead aerial or street-level perspective. Iconic urban energy. 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 创作东京涩谷十字路口夜间的电影感摄影。数百人同时从各方向穿越。人流与车流的长曝光光轨。巨型LED广告牌以蓝白光照亮场景。俯视或街道视角。标志性城市能量。比例 16:9。

entries.title: 日本陶艺侘寂
entries.description: 日本陶艺侘寂之美，裂痕与不完美是金继美学的诗意，粗糙质感中蕴藏生命的哲学。
entries.prompt: Create a wabi-sabi Japanese pottery still life photograph. Handmade ceramic vessels with intentional imperfections — crazing, texture, asymmetry. Kintsugi gold-repaired cracks glowing. Natural neutral surface. Raking light emphasizing texture. A single flower or moss. The beauty of imperfection. 4:5.
entries.promptZh: 创作侘寂日本陶艺静物摄影。手工陶瓷器皿带有刻意的不完美——龟裂、肌理、不对称。金继修复的黄金裂缝发光。自然中性台面。斜射光强调质感。一朵花或苔藓。不完美的美。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 食材爆炸漂浮摄影
entries.description: 食材漂浮爆炸摄影，新鲜食材在空中定格，色彩鲜艳的视觉盛宴传递食品的新鲜活力。
entries.prompt: Create a vibrant floating ingredients explosion photograph for Japanese ceremonial matcha — bamboo whisk and ceramic bowl. Fresh ingredients — vegetables, fruits, spices, herbs — exploding outward from central product, each perfectly sharp and frozen mid-air. Clean white background. Studio strobe freezing motion. Vivid saturated natural food colors. 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 为【[食品/品牌]】创作充满活力的食材漂浮爆炸摄影。新鲜食材——蔬菜、水果、香料、香草——从中心产品向外爆炸性飞散，每一个都完美清晰地凝固在空中。纯白背景。工作室闪光灯冻结运动。鲜艳饱和的天然食物色彩。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 高端耳机编辑摄影
entries.description: 高端耳机编辑广告摄影，精准光影勾勒出工业设计的美感，音乐与科技的感官想象。
entries.prompt: Create premium headphones editorial product photography for Bang & Olufsen Beoplay H95 in gold tone. Headphones floating or on a model, dramatic studio lighting revealing acoustic mesh detail and material quality. Sound visualization: floating musical notes or audio waveform. Dark premium background. Apple/Sony campaign quality. 4:5.
entries.promptZh: 为【[品牌]】创作高端耳机编辑产品摄影。耳机漂浮或佩戴于模特头上，戏剧性工作室灯光揭示声学网格细节与材质品质。声音可视化：漂浮音符或音频波形。深色高端背景。苹果/索尼广告品质。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 奢华巧克力微距摄影
entries.description: 顶级巧克力微距摄影，截面的层次质感与可可颗粒的细节，让人无法抗拒的感官诱惑。
entries.prompt: Create ultra-luxury chocolate macro photography for VALRHONA Manjari 64% dark chocolate. Extreme close-up of chocolate bar breaking, revealing interior layers and air bubbles. Perfect snap caught mid-action. Dark deep chocolate brown with golden reflections. Cocoa powder dust in air. Premium confectionery advertising quality. 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 为【[品牌]】创作超级奢华巧克力微距摄影。巧克力棒断裂的极致近景，揭示内部层次与气泡。完美的断裂瞬间捕捉。深沉浓郁巧克力棕色搭配金色反光。空气中的可可粉尘。高端糖果广告品质。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 护肤品平铺摄影
entries.description: 高端护肤品平铺摄影，精心搭配的瓶瓶罐罐与自然植物，传递纯净护肤的品牌哲学。
entries.prompt: Create a premium skincare flatlay product photograph for La Mer The Moisturizing Cream. Multiple product lineup — serums, moisturizer, toner — arranged in a precise overhead flat lay. Clean white or soft pink surface. Fresh botanical elements: aloe, rose petals, green leaves. Soft even overhead studio light. Clean clinical beauty aesthetic. 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 为【[品牌]】创作高端护肤品平铺产品摄影。多个产品系列——精华、保湿霜、化妆水——在精准的俯视平铺中排列。干净白色或柔粉色台面。新鲜植物元素：芦荟、玫瑰花瓣、绿叶。柔和均匀的顶部工作室光线。干净临床美妆美学。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 奢华蜡烛情绪摄影
entries.description: 奢华香薰蜡烛情绪摄影，烛光在黑暗中的温柔晕染，让产品传递仪式感与生活品质。
entries.prompt: Create luxury candle mood product photography for AESOP Petrichor candle. Single or pair of candles lit in dramatic darkness. The warm flame glow is the sole light source, creating intimate amber atmosphere. Marble, dark wood, or concrete surface. Dried botanicals nearby. Minimal props, maximum atmosphere. 4:5.
entries.promptZh: 为【[品牌]】创作奢华蜡烛情绪产品摄影。一支或两支点燃蜡烛在戏剧性黑暗中。温暖烛光是唯一光源，营造亲密琥珀氛围。大理石、深色木材或混凝土台面。附近摆放干燥植物。最少道具，最大氛围感。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 雨窗反射人像
entries.description: 雨天玻璃窗前的反射人像，水珠与城市灯光折射出朦胧诗意，孤独与沉思的情绪摄影。
entries.prompt: Create a moody rain window reflection portrait. Face looking out through rain-streaked glass, the outside city lights refracted into bokeh trails through each raindrop. Inside darkness, outside neon glow. Solitude and contemplation mood. Cool blue tones with warm light pops. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作忧郁的雨窗反射人像。面孔透过雨迹玻璃向外凝视，窗外城市灯光通过每滴雨珠折射成虚化光轨。室内昏暗，室外霓虹发光。孤独与沉思的情绪。冷蓝色调搭配温暖光斑点缀。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 男性编辑时尚人像
entries.description: 男性时尚编辑人像，简洁背景与强烈光影，传递男性气质与当代时尚杂志的高级感。
entries.prompt: Create a strong editorial male headshot/portrait. Clean studio or architectural background. Strong architectural lighting — Rembrandt or split light. Sharp jaw, direct gaze into camera. Minimal styling: plain t-shirt or white shirt. Confidence and masculinity. High-end fashion magazine quality. 4:5.
entries.promptZh: 创作强有力的男性编辑头像/人像。干净工作室或建筑背景。强烈建筑感光线——伦勃朗光或分色光。锐利下颚，直视镜头。极简造型：素色T恤或白衬衫。自信与男性气质。高端时尚杂志品质。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 黑色电影人像
entries.description: 1940年代好莱坞黑色电影风格人像，威尼斯百叶窗投影与烟雾，永恒的黑白电影美学。
entries.prompt: Create a film noir style black and white portrait. Venetian blind shadow stripes across the face from a side window. Cigarette smoke curl. Deep shadows under cheekbones and eyes. Detective office or dimly lit bar setting behind subject. 1940s Hollywood aesthetic. High contrast silver gelatin print quality. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作黑色电影风格黑白人像。侧窗百叶窗条纹阴影投在脸上。烟雾旋绕。颧骨与眼睛下方的深沉阴影。人物身后的侦探办公室或昏暗酒吧场景。1940年代好莱坞美学。高对比银盐印相品质。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 建筑蓝图艺术
entries.description: 建筑蓝图风格艺术插画，白色精细线条在深蓝底上描绘建筑或机械，理性美学的极致。
entries.prompt: Create an architectural blueprint style art illustration of the Sagrada Família cathedral by Gaudí. White or cyan technical line drawing on deep navy blue background. Multiple views: elevation, section, plan. Fine hatching and dimension lines. Grid overlay. Precise and beautiful technical drafting. 4:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作【[建筑/物体]】的建筑蓝图风格艺术插画。深海军蓝背景上的白色或青色技术线图。多视图：立面、剖面、平面。精细剖面线与尺寸标注线。网格叠加。精确而美丽的技术制图。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 麻胶版画艺术
entries.description: 麻胶版画印刷艺术，刀刻痕迹与高对比黑白构图，原始而有力的手工印刷美学。
entries.prompt: Create a linocut print style artwork of a lone wolf howling at the full moon on a rocky ridge. Bold black and white high-contrast composition with characteristic gouge marks and cut textures. Organic irregular edges to shapes. No gradients — pure positive/negative space. Handmade print aesthetic. Simple powerful imagery: animal, landscape, or portrait. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作【[主题]】的麻胶版画风格艺术作品。大胆的黑白高对比构图，带有特征性的凿刻痕迹与刀切纹理。形状边缘有机不规则。无渐变——纯粹正负空间。手工印刷美学。简洁有力的图像：动物、风景或人像。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 角色概念设计
entries.description: 游戏或影视角色概念设计，三视图展示与装备细节，工业级概念艺术家的创作语言。
entries.prompt: Create a character concept art sheet for Rei — an ancient forest spirit guardian with flowing moss-covered robes. Front, side, and 3/4 view poses. Detailed costume/armor/equipment design. Color palette swatches. Callout lines indicating material and design notes. Epic fantasy, sci-fi, or steampunk genre aesthetic. Professional game art or film pre-production quality. 4:3.
entries.promptZh: 为【[角色名/类型]】创作角色概念设计图。正面、侧面与3/4视角姿态。详细服装/盔甲/装备设计。配色方案色块。引线标注材质与设计说明。史诗奇幻、科幻或蒸汽朋克风格美学。专业游戏美术或电影前期制作品质。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 时装设计手稿
entries.description: 时装设计师风格手稿插画，纤细流畅的人体线稿与服装细节，高定时装的艺术笔记。
entries.prompt: Create a fashion design sketch illustration for a sculptural floor-length evening gown with dramatic train. Elongated fashion figure (croquis) in dynamic pose. Loose gestural ink or pencil lines for body structure. Detailed watercolor or marker rendering of the garment. Fabric texture and drape suggested with minimal strokes. Sketchbook aesthetic with handwritten notes. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 为【[服装/系列]】创作时装设计手稿插画。修长时装人体（croquis）以动态姿态呈现。松散手势墨线或铅笔线条描绘人体结构。服装以水彩或马克笔详细渲染。最少笔触暗示面料质感与垂坠感。速写本美学搭配手写注释。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 天文星空海报
entries.description: 天文学教育海报，深邃星云与星座图案，科学与浪漫并存的宇宙视觉探索。
entries.prompt: Create an astronomy night sky educational poster. Deep space photography style showing nebula, star clusters, or constellation map. Rich deep space colors: midnight blue, violet, gold star points. Scientific constellation line overlay with Latin names. Vintage observatory chart meets modern astrophotography. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作天文学夜空教育海报。深空摄影风格展示星云、星团或星座图。丰富的深空色彩：午夜蓝、紫罗兰、金色星点。星座连线叠加拉丁名称。复古天文台图表与现代天体摄影的融合。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 构成主义宣传海报
entries.description: 苏联构成主义风格海报，对角线构图与工人人物剪影，强烈的政治美学与历史张力。
entries.prompt: Create a Soviet Constructivist style propaganda poster for Protect the Oceans — Our Planet Needs You. Dramatic diagonal composition with bold geometric shapes. Silhouetted heroic figures of workers or athletes. Limited palette: red, black, cream, yellow. Cyrillic-inspired bold sans-serif typography at dynamic angles. Authentic 1920s-30s Russian avant-garde aesthetic. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 为【[主题]】创作苏联构成主义风格宣传海报。戏剧性对角线构图，大胆几何形状。工人或运动员英雄剪影。有限色板：红、黑、奶油、黄。西里尔字体灵感的粗黑无衬线字体以动态角度排列。真实1920-30年代俄罗斯先锋美学。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 包豪斯几何海报
entries.description: 包豪斯风格几何构成海报，原色圆形与线条的精确排布，工业设计与艺术的完美统一。
entries.prompt: Create a Bauhaus-style geometric composition poster. Pure primary color shapes — circles, triangles, rectangles — arranged with mathematical precision. Black, red, blue, yellow on white. Herbert Bayer or Moholy-Nagy inspired. Strong typographic integration with sans-serif in various weights. Modernist functional beauty. 3:4.
entries.promptZh: 创作包豪斯风格几何构成海报。纯原色几何——圆形、三角形、矩形——以数学精度排列。白底上的黑、红、蓝、黄。赫伯特·拜耶或莫霍利-纳吉灵感。无衬线字体多重量级排印强力融入。现代主义功能之美。比例 3:4。

entries.title: 电影院线海报
entries.description: 好莱坞院线级电影海报设计，电影感光影与人物构图，大片的视觉冲击感。
entries.prompt: Design a Hollywood-style cinematic movie poster for Blade Runner 2049. Dramatic character composition with strong key light, wide-angle lens distortion. Title treatment with layered glow effects and supporting cast credits in fine print. Epic sky or environment background. Moody desaturated color grade with teal-orange LUT. 2:3 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 为【[电影名称]】设计好莱坞风格电影海报。戏剧性人物构图，强主光、广角畸变。标题搭配多层发光效果，下方演职员表细字。史诗性天空或环境背景。青橙色调低饱和电影级色调。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 时尚配饰平铺摄影
entries.description: 时尚配饰平铺摄影，包袋、珠宝与香水的精心组合，构建一套有品位的时尚叙事。
entries.prompt: Create an editorial fashion accessories flat lay photograph for Loewe — Summer 2025 Collection. Premium accessories arranged in a perfectly styled overhead shot: designer bag, sunglasses, jewelry, perfume bottle, silk scarf. Shot on linen, marble, or colored paper surface. Precise arrangement with intentional asymmetry. Soft diffused light with minimal shadows. Cohesive color story. Net-a-Porter, Vogue editorial still life quality. Ratio 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 为【[品牌/季节]】创作一张编辑风时尚配饰平铺摄影。俯视角度精心造型的顶级配饰排列：设计师包袋、太阳镜、珠宝、香水瓶、丝质围巾。置于亚麻布、大理石或彩色纸面拍摄。精准排布，刻意的不对称感。柔和漫射光，阴影极简。统一的色彩故事。Net-a-Porter、Vogue 编辑静物品质。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 泳装海滩大片
entries.description: 高端泳装海滩编辑大片，阳光、沙滩与完美曝光，活力四射的夏日时尚语言。
entries.prompt: Create a luxury swimwear editorial beach campaign photograph. Model in elegant designer swimwear on pristine white sand or rocky coastal setting. Perfect outdoor natural light — late afternoon golden hour or bright midday. Ocean backdrop in deep turquoise. Dynamic confident pose — walking, leaping, or reclining. Vibrant saturated colors: tropical bright and warm. Sports Illustrated, Vogue swimsuit editorial quality. Ratio 4:5.
entries.promptZh: 创作一张奢华泳装编辑海滩广告摄影。模特穿着优雅设计师泳装，置于洁白沙滩或岩石海岸场景。完美户外自然光——下午黄金时段或明亮正午阳光。背景是深绿松石色海洋。充满动感自信的姿态——行走、跃动或卧姿。鲜艳饱和色彩：热带明艳与温暖。《体育画报》、《Vogue》泳装大片编辑品质。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 环保品牌包装设计
entries.description: 可持续环保品牌包装，原色纸板与植物油墨，传递品牌的环境责任感与自然美学。
entries.prompt: Create an eco-friendly sustainable brand packaging design for organic loose-leaf herbal tea. Unbleached kraft paper and cardboard boxes with soy-ink botanical illustrations. Earthy natural color palette: forest green, terracotta, sand, natural kraft. Minimal printing — only what's necessary. Seed paper hang tags, cotton twine. Product feels naturally responsible. Aesop, Seed, Pela brand aesthetic. Ratio 4:3.
entries.promptZh: 为【[产品]】创作一款环保可持续品牌包装设计。未漂白牛皮纸和硬纸板盒，配有大豆油墨植物插画。大地自然色调：森林绿、赤陶、沙色、天然牛皮色。最小化印刷——只印必要内容。种子纸吊牌、棉绳。产品散发天然负责任的气质。Aesop、Seed、Pela 品牌美学。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 时尚杂志编辑版式
entries.description: 高端时尚杂志编辑版式，大胆的字体层级与精致的图文排版，纸媒的黄金时代重现。
entries.prompt: Create a high-end fashion magazine editorial spread layout for VOGUE — The Future of Fashion Issue. Double-page spread design with bold typographic hierarchy — large display headline, pull quotes, body text columns. Fashion photography integrated into asymmetric grid. White space used confidently. Modern serif meets grotesque type system. Clean minimal design with bold editorial personality. Vogue, Porter, Kinfolk magazine quality. Ratio 3:4.
entries.promptZh: 为【[杂志/主题]】创作一个高端时尚杂志编辑版式展开页设计。跨页版式，带有大胆字体层级——大标题展示字、引用语、正文分栏。时尚摄影融入非对称网格。留白运用大胆。现代衬线字体与无衬线字体系统结合。简洁极简设计与大胆编辑个性兼备。Vogue、Porter、Kinfolk 杂志品质。比例 3:4。

entries.title: 奢侈品礼品包装设计
entries.description: 奢华礼品包装设计，厚实磨砂纸盒与金箔烫印，未开封时已令人心生期待。
entries.prompt: Create a luxurious gift packaging design for BOTTEGA VENETA. Premium matte black or deep jewel-tone box with embossed gold foil logo and hot-stamped typography. Silk ribbon, tissue paper peek, dried flower detail. Shot on neutral stone or marble surface. Soft diffused studio lighting revealing surface texture. Unboxing experience focus. La Mer, Valmont, Hermès packaging aesthetic. Ratio 4:3.
entries.promptZh: 为【[品牌]】创作一款奢华礼品包装设计。高端哑光黑色或深宝石色礼盒，配有浮雕金箔 Logo 和烫金字体。丝缎蝴蝶结、露出一角的薄纸、干花细节点缀。置于中性石材或大理石台面拍摄。柔和漫射工作室灯光凸显表面质感。专注开箱体验感。海蓝之谜、维瓦尔特、爱马仕包装美学。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 霓虹水母深海三维
entries.description: 深海霓虹水母三维艺术，生物发光水母群在深蓝海底漂浮，梦幻而神秘的深海奇境。
entries.prompt: Create a magical deep ocean neon jellyfish 3D render. Multiple translucent bioluminescent jellyfish of various sizes floating in dark deep ocean water. Their bodies emit soft glowing neon light: electric blue, magenta, sea-green. Long trailing tentacles with particle effects. Deep dark navy ocean background with subtle light caustics. Ultra-realistic 3D render with painterly atmosphere. Dreamy and otherworldly. Ratio 4:5.
entries.promptZh: 创作一张神奇的深海霓虹水母三维渲染。各种大小的半透明生物发光水母漂浮于深邃幽暗的深海水域。水母身体散发柔和发光的霓虹光芒：电光蓝、品红、海绿。长触须拖曳着粒子效果。深海军蓝海底背景带有微妙焦散光纹。超写实三维渲染搭配绘画般的氛围感。梦幻而超凡脱俗。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 微缩地球三维场景
entries.description: 微缩星球三维场景，手掌大小的微型地球漂浮在宇宙中，山川湖海尽在掌中，梦幻可爱。
entries.prompt: Create a charming miniature planet 3D diorama render. A small spherical planet floating in space, hand-sized scale — featuring tiny detailed landscapes: mountains, forests, waterfalls, small houses, clouds. Soft warm studio lighting from above. Deep space gradient background with subtle stars. Tilt-shift focus effect making it look like a tiny toy. Dreamy pastel color palette. Ratio 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 创作一张迷人的微缩星球三维场景渲染。一个悬浮在太空中的小球形星球，手掌大小——包含精细的微型地貌：山脉、森林、瀑布、小房屋、云朵。来自上方的柔和温暖工作室灯光。带有微妙星星的深空渐变背景。移轴模糊效果令其看起来像小玩具。梦幻马卡龙色调。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 流体玻璃雕塑三维
entries.description: 流体玻璃三维雕塑，液态玻璃凝固于最美的流动瞬间，透明与反射的视觉奇迹。
entries.prompt: Create a stunning glass fluid sculpture 3D render. A single abstract fluid form frozen mid-flow — perhaps twisting ribbons, a breaking wave, or cascading liquid. Perfect photorealistic glass material: caustics, total internal reflection, refraction. Minimalist gradient background (soft dove grey to white). Studio three-point lighting system. Ultra-high quality CGI render. Perfect for product design or art portfolio. Ratio 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 创作一张令人惊叹的流体玻璃雕塑三维渲染。单一抽象流体形态在运动中凝固——扭转的缎带、破碎的浪花或瀑布般的液体。完美的超写实玻璃材质：焦散光、全内反射、折射。极简渐变背景（柔和鸽灰到白色）。三点工作室灯光系统。超高质量 CGI 渲染。完美适用于产品设计或艺术作品集。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 赛博朋克机器女孩
entries.description: 赛博朋克机器女孩，半透明机械肌肤下流动的数据光流，东方面孔与未来机械完美融合。
entries.prompt: Create a cyberpunk android girl anime illustration. Beautiful female android with partially visible mechanical components beneath translucent synthetic skin. Glowing circuit patterns under skin and in eyes. Rain-soaked neon megacity background. Half-mechanical, half-human aesthetic. Cold blue-purple-magenta color palette. Ghost in the Shell and Blame! visual DNA. Ultra-detailed dark sci-fi anime art. Ratio 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作一张赛博朋克机器女孩动漫插画。美丽的女性机器人，半透明合成皮肤下可见部分机械结构。皮肤下和眼中发光的电路纹样。雨水浸透的霓虹大都市背景。半机械半人类美学。冷调蓝紫品红色板。攻壳机动队和BLAME!视觉基因。超细节黑暗科幻动漫艺术。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 月下武士决斗
entries.description: 月下武士对决，水墨与动漫融合，月光与刀光交织，东方武侠气概跃然纸上。
entries.prompt: Create a dramatic samurai moonlit duel anime illustration with ink wash aesthetic. Two samurai in silhouette facing off, katana drawn, on a misty mountain cliff under a massive full moon. Ink brush stroke style for trees, grass, and atmosphere. Motion blur on drawn blades. Deep indigo night sky. Inspired by Rurouni Kenshin and Demon Slayer visual style. Epic vertical composition. Ratio 9:16.
entries.promptZh: 以水墨美学创作一张戏剧性的月下武士决斗动漫插画。两位武士剪影在薄雾弥漫的山崖上对峙，拔刀出鞘，背后是巨大满月。树木、草地和大气感以水墨笔触风格表现。出鞘刀刃的动态模糊。深靛青夜空。受浪客剑心和鬼灭之刃视觉风格启发。史诗竖版构图。比例 9:16。

entries.title: 大阪街道黄昏
entries.description: 大阪道顿堀黄昏，霓虹招牌在暮色中渐次亮起，人潮涌动，烟火气与华灯初上共存。
entries.prompt: Create a cinematic Osaka Dotonbori street dusk photograph. The famous neon signs and giant crab/blowfish decorations illuminating the dusk sky. Crowded pedestrian bridge with motion blur crowds. Canal reflections of neon signs in deep blue water. Blue hour sky transitioning to warm neon artificial light. Street food smells implied by steaming yatai stalls. Classic Osaka nightlife energy. Ratio 3:4.
entries.promptZh: 拍摄一张电影感的大阪道顿堀黄昏街道照片。著名霓虹招牌和巨型螃蟹/河豚装饰在暮色天空中亮起。行人天桥上人潮涌动带有动态模糊。深蓝色运河水面映照霓虹倒影。蓝调时分天空过渡到温暖的霓虹人工光。冒着热气的屋台摊位暗示街头美食气息。经典大阪夜生活能量。比例 3:4。

entries.title: 拉面店蒸汽内景
entries.description: 昭和时代拉面店内景，蒸汽弥漫的吧台旁一碗热拉面，暖黄灯光与陈年木质散发时光气息。
entries.prompt: Create an atmospheric Showa-era Japanese ramen shop interior photograph. Narrow counter with wooden stools, chef behind pass with steaming pots, warm amber incandescent lighting. A perfect bowl of ramen in foreground with rising steam, nori, chashu, soft egg. Aged wood surfaces, vintage Japanese signage, worn patina everywhere. Film grain, warm kodachrome tones. Ratio 4:3.
entries.promptZh: 拍摄一张充满氛围的昭和时代日本拉面店内景。木制凳子排列的狭长吧台，厨师在蒸腾锅炉后忙碌，温暖的琥珀白炽灯光。近景是一碗冒着热气的完美拉面，点缀海苔、叉烧、溏心蛋。老化木质表面、复古日文招牌、磨损的包浆无处不在。胶片颗粒，温暖柯达彩色调。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 超写实美食摄影
entries.description: 超写实美食摄影，食材的每个细节都诱人至极，光影与色泽让人垂涎，纯粹的感官享受。
entries.prompt: Create hyperrealistic commercial food photography of a perfect wagyu A5 beef burger with melting aged cheddar. The food is styled to perfection — hero portion at ideal temperature with visible steam, fresh ingredients glistening, sauces glossy, textures exaggerated. Precise overhead or 45-degree angle. Complementary props and surface. Perfect studio strobe lighting with fill. Extreme detail: every grain of salt, sesame seed, herb leaf visible. Michelin-starred restaurant menu quality. Ratio 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 为【[菜品/食材]】创作一张超写实商业美食摄影。食物造型完美——主体份量处于理想温度，可见蒸汽，新鲜食材晶莹剔透，酱汁光泽饱满，质感夸张化。精准俯视或45度角构图。搭配互补道具与台面材质。完美工作室闪光灯搭配补光。极致细节：每颗盐粒、芝麻、香草叶清晰可见。米其林星级餐厅菜单品质。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 球鞋品牌广告大片
entries.description: 球鞋品牌广告大片，动感爆炸式视觉与街头文化能量，将球鞋推上文化符号的神坛。
entries.prompt: Create an epic sneaker brand campaign advertisement for Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Chicago. Sneaker as hero object floating or in extreme motion, surrounded by explosive visual elements: paint splashes, light trails, particle explosions. Urban concrete environment or pure studio. Cinematic side lighting making shoe materials shine. Bold brand energy — street culture meets high art. Dynamic widescreen composition. Nike/Adidas campaign quality. Ratio 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 为【[球鞋型号]】创作一张史诗级球鞋品牌广告大片。球鞋作为主角悬浮或处于极限运动中，周围爆发式视觉元素：颜料飞溅、光轨、粒子爆炸。城市混凝土环境或纯净工作室。电影感侧光令鞋身材质熠熠生辉。大胆品牌能量——街头文化与高艺术的碰撞。动感宽银幕构图。耐克/阿迪达斯广告级品质。比例 16:9。

entries.title: 建筑感腕表广告大片
entries.description: 腕表广告大片，建筑线条与精密机芯相呼应，冷调金属光影彰显顶级制表工艺。
entries.prompt: Create a high-end architectural watch advertisement for PATEK PHILIPPE Nautilus 5711. The timepiece floats in a dramatic architectural space — marble columns, steel grid ceiling, or brutalist concrete. Single dramatic spotlight creates razor-sharp shadow geometry. Watch reflection in polished surface. Cold steel-blue color grade with warm gold dial glow. Monochrome palette with metallic accents. Swiss luxury watch campaign quality. Ratio 4:5.
entries.promptZh: 为【[腕表品牌]】创作一张高端建筑感腕表广告。腕表漂浮于戏剧性建筑空间中——大理石廊柱、钢制网格天花板或野兽主义混凝土。单束戏剧性聚光灯制造锋利阴影几何。腕表在抛光表面的倒影。冷钢蓝色调搭配温暖金色表盘光芒。单色系搭配金属点缀。瑞士奢侈腕表广告品质。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 茶道产品摄影
entries.description: 东方茶道美学产品摄影，自然质感道具衬托茶器之美，空灵禅意与东方留白哲学。
entries.prompt: Create a minimalist Japanese tea ceremony product photography for Japanese ceremonial-grade Matcha powder. Handmade ceramic tea vessel as hero product on raw linen or slate surface. Supporting props: bamboo whisk, small stone, fresh tea leaves, morning steam. Soft diffused natural window light from one side. Extreme minimalism — maximum 4 elements. Wabi-sabi imperfection in ceramics. Neutral warm palette: cream, slate, forest green. Editorial still-life quality. Ratio 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 为【[茶品]】创作一张极简日本茶道产品摄影。手工陶瓷茶器作为主产品，置于原色亚麻或石板表面。辅助道具：竹制茶筅、小石头、新鲜茶叶、晨雾蒸汽。单侧柔和自然窗光。极致简约，最多4个元素。陶器的侘寂不完美感。中性暖色调：奶油色、石板灰、森林绿。精品静物摄影品质。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 霓虹艺术面孔
entries.description: 霓虹彩绘艺术人像，荧光颜料在暗室中发光，前卫的艺术妆容将人脸变为发光画布。
entries.prompt: Create an artistic neon UV body/face paint portrait. Model's face and neck covered in intricate fluorescent neon body art — geometric patterns, tribal-inspired designs, or floral motifs glowing under UV black light. Pure black background making neon colors explode: electric blue, magenta, lime green, orange. Studio beauty photography meets fine art body painting. Close-up or half-body composition. Ratio 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 创作一张紫外线荧光体彩/面部彩绘艺术人像。模特面部和颈部覆盖着精美的霓虹荧光彩绘——几何图案、部落风设计或花卉图腾在紫外光下发光。纯黑背景让霓虹色彩爆炸般呈现：电光蓝、品红、荧光绿、橙色。工作室美妆摄影与精细艺术彩绘的结合。近景或半身构图。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 儿童绘本封面
entries.description: 温暖治愈的儿童绘本封面，圆润可爱的角色与魔法世界，笔触柔软，充满纯真童趣。
entries.prompt: Create a charming children's picture book cover illustration featuring a tiny fox who collects fallen stars in a glass jar. Warm, inviting painterly style with soft rounded shapes and friendly character design. Gentle watercolor-gouache textures. Magical enchanted setting: cozy forest, candy-colored village, or storybook cottage. Warm golden light and soft shadow. Pastel and warm earth tone palette. Title space at top or bottom. Award-winning picture book quality (Caldecott style). Ratio 3:4.
entries.promptZh: 创作一幅温馨可爱的儿童绘本封面插画，主题为【[角色/故事]】。温暖、迷人的绘画风格，圆润造型与友善角色设计。柔和的水粉-水彩笔触。魔法童话场景：温馨森林、糖果小镇或故事书小屋。温暖金色光线与柔和阴影。马卡龙色系搭配暖大地色调。预留标题位置。凯迪克奖级儿童绘本品质。比例 3:4。

entries.title: 超现实梦境插画
entries.description: 达利风格超现实主义插画，物理规则被颠覆，漂浮岛屿与熔融时钟共存于梦境空间。
entries.prompt: Create a surrealist dreamscape illustration inspired by Dalí and Magritte for the sensation of falling upward through infinite golden skies. Physics defying impossible space: floating islands and staircases, melting objects, scale inversions, open sky within closed rooms. Photorealistic rendering of impossible combinations. Dramatic lighting with long shadows. Dreamlike color palette: warm golden light, deep cerulean shadows, impossible vistas. Fine art oil painting quality. Ratio 4:3.
entries.promptZh: 以达利和马格利特为灵感，创作一幅超现实梦境插画，主题为【[主题]】。违背物理法则的不可能空间：漂浮岛屿与楼梯、熔化物体、比例颠倒、密室中打开的天空。对不可能的组合进行超写实渲染。戏剧性光影与长条阴影。梦境色调：温暖金色光线、深群青阴影、奇异远景。精细油画品质。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 植物科学插画
entries.description: 18世纪博物馆级植物手绘插画，精细解剖细节与科学标注，兼具艺术美感与学术价值。
entries.prompt: Create a museum-quality botanical scientific illustration of Passiflora caerulea (Blue Passionflower). 18th century naturalist style with meticulous hand-drawn details showing leaves, stems, roots, flowers, seeds and cross-sections. Clean off-white parchment background. Precise watercolor and ink rendering with Latin scientific annotations and detailed labels. Scale ruler and specimen numbering. Royal Botanical Gardens archive quality. Ratio 3:4.
entries.promptZh: 绘制一幅博物馆级植物科学插画，描绘【[植物名称]】。18世纪博物学家风格，精细手绘展示叶片、茎、根、花、种子及横截面。干净的羊皮纸底色。精准的水彩与钢笔渲染，附拉丁文学名标注和详细标签。附比例尺和标本编号。皇家植物园档案级品质。比例 3:4。

entries.title: 新艺术运动装饰海报
entries.description: 穆夏风格装饰海报，流动曲线、女神人物与植物纹样框架，金色细腻，永恒之美。
entries.prompt: Create an Art Nouveau decorative poster in Alphonse Mucha style for a goddess of spring surrounded by wisteria and cherry blossoms. Central goddess or female figure surrounded by elaborate botanical and floral ornamental border frame. Flowing organic lines and whiplash curves. Soft muted palette with gold accents, sage green, dusky rose, cream. Intricate circular halo or arch above figure. Elegant serif lettering integrated into floral frame. Fine lithographic print quality. Ratio 9:16.
entries.promptZh: 以阿尔丰斯·穆夏风格设计一张新艺术运动装饰海报，主题为【[主题]】。中心为女神或女性人物，周围环绕精美植物与花卉装饰边框。流动的有机线条与鞭形曲线。柔和哑光色调搭配金色点缀，鼠尾草绿、暮玫瑰、奶油色。人物头顶精美圆形光环或拱形。优雅的衬线字体融入花卉边框。石版印刷般精细质感。比例 9:16。

entries.title: 瑞士风格平面设计海报
entries.description: 国际主义风格海报，严格网格系统、无衬线字体与几何色块，彰显功能主义设计美学。
entries.prompt: Create a Swiss International Typographic Style poster for Bauhaus Architecture — 100 Years Exhibition. Strict mathematical grid system with clean geometric composition. Bold primary colors: red, black, white with minimal accents. Helvetica or Akzidenz-Grotesk style sans-serif typography at multiple scales, flush-left alignment. Strong diagonal or horizontal axis. Photography or geometric shapes cropped to grid. No decoration — pure function. Ratio 3:4.
entries.promptZh: 以瑞士国际主义字体风格设计一张海报，主题为【[主题]】。运用严格的数学网格系统构图。大胆使用原色：红、黑、白，极少点缀。以 Helvetica 或 Akzidenz-Grotesk 无衬线字体排版，多级字号、左对齐。强烈的斜向或水平轴线。摄影或几何图形按网格裁剪。去除一切装饰，追求纯粹功能主义。比例 3:4。

entries.title: 夜市街头写真
entries.description: 亚洲夜市霓虹氛围，红发女孩置身街头小摊之间，暖黄灯光与霓虹混搭，纪实街头摄影风格。
entries.prompt: Street photography portrait at a vibrant Asian night market. Subject: a young woman with {argument name="hair" default="striking dyed red hair"}, wearing {argument name="outfit" default="vintage band tee and high-waisted jeans"}. She is surrounded by night market food stalls with warm glowing lanterns and neon signage in Chinese characters. Mixed lighting: warm incandescent from stalls, cool neon accents. Crowd blurred in background through slow shutter. Authentic documentary street photography — slightly gritty, real, alive. 35mm f/2, high ISO grain visible. The energy of the night market frames her perfectly. 2:3 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 充满活力的亚洲夜市街头摄影人像。拍摄对象：一位拥有【{argument name="hair" default="醒目染色红发"}】的年轻女性，身穿【{argument name="outfit" default="复古乐队 T 恤和高腰牛仔裤"}】。她置身于夜市小摊之间，暖光灯笼和中文霓虹招牌环绕。混合光线：摊位的暖白炽灯与冷色霓虹点缀。慢快门将背景人群虚化。真实纪录片式街头摄影——略有粗粝感、真实、充满活力。35mm f/2，高感光度颗粒清晰可见。夜市的生命力将她完美衬托。2:3 竖幅。

entries.title: 健康生活拼图
entries.description: 网格拼贴展现健康生活方式，瑜伽、蔬果、冥想场景，莫兰迪色系，clean girl 美学…
entries.prompt: Aesthetic wellness and healthy lifestyle mood board collage in a clean grid layout. {argument name="grid" default="9 squares, 3x3"}. Content includes: morning yoga pose in golden light, vibrant green smoothie bowl with toppings, hands holding crystal or journal, fresh produce arrangement, minimalist bathroom ritual, aerial view of workout clothes laid flat. Color palette: muted earthy tones — sage green, warm cream, terracotta, dusty pink. Clean girl aesthetic. Each panel has consistent soft lighting. Instagram-worthy flat lay and lifestyle photography style. Delicate typography labels optional.
entries.promptZh: 干净网格排版的健康生活方式情绪板拼贴画。【{argument name="grid" default="九宫格，3x3 排列"}】。内容包含：黄金时刻清晨瑜伽姿势、点缀配料的鲜绿色冰沙碗、手持水晶或日记本、新鲜农产品造型排列、极简浴室护肤仪式、俯拍运动服装平铺。调色板：柔和大地色调——鼠尾草绿、温暖米白、赭土色、藕粉色。Clean girl 美学。每格均有统一柔和光线。Instagram 美观的平铺和生活方式摄影风格。可选精致排版标签。

entries.title: 博物馆风格解构信息图
entries.description: 中国博物馆展品风格，将日常物品拆解为解构信息图，繁体标注、印章、仿古纸质感，知识性与美…
entries.prompt: Chinese museum collection style deconstruction infographic of {argument name="subject" default="a traditional tea set"}. Rendered as if it were a museum display with detailed anatomical breakdown. White or aged parchment background. Traditional Chinese ink illustration style with fine line work. Numbered callouts in classical Chinese typography. Official museum seal stamp in red. Annotation in both classical Chinese and modern characters. Top classification header in museum catalog style. The object is shown from multiple angles — front, side, cross-section. Scholarly and artistic simultaneously. Gold foil accent details.
entries.promptZh: 中国博物馆藏品风格解构信息图，主题为【{argument name="subject" default="传统茶具"}】。以博物馆展示方式呈现，含详细解剖分解。白色或仿古羊皮纸背景。传统中国水墨插画风格，细腻线条。古典中文排版的编号标注。红色官方博物馆印章。古典汉字与现代字体双语标注。顶部博物馆图录风格分类标题。从多角度展示物件——正面、侧面、剖面。学术性与艺术性并存。金箔装饰细节。

entries.title: 融化冰淇淋夏日写真
entries.description: 夏日阳光下，金发少女手持融化的冰淇淋甜筒，Kodak 胶片粒感，复古滤镜，年轻活力的夏…
entries.prompt: Playful summer portrait of {argument name="subject" default="a blonde girl"} holding a dripping melting {argument name="ice cream" default="rainbow sherbet ice cream cone"} in bright summer sunlight. Melted ice cream dripping down her fingers and wrist. She's wearing {argument name="outfit" default="a pastel yellow sundress"}. Squinting joyfully in the sun. Bright, overexposed summer light. Shooting on Kodak Portra 400 film, vintage color grading, slight grain. Warm golden tones. Candid carefree teenage energy. Blurred summer background — beach or garden. 4:5 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 【{argument name="subject" default="金发女孩"}】手持融化的【{argument name="ice cream" default="彩虹雪葩冰淇淋甜筒"}】的趣味夏日写真，在明媚夏日阳光下拍摄。融化的冰淇淋沿手指和手腕滴落。她穿着【{argument name="outfit" default="淡黄色阳光裙"}】。在阳光下眯眼欢笑。明亮、过曝的夏日光线。使用柯达 Portra 400 胶片拍摄，复古色彩调色，轻微颗粒感。温暖的金色调。随性自由的青春气息。模糊的夏日背景——海滩或花园。4:5 竖幅。

entries.title: 洋甘菊美妆人像
entries.description: 户外黄金时刻美妆写真，洋甘菊花环点缀，透明感水光肌，自然散景背景，韩系清新美妆风格。
entries.prompt: Soft beauty portrait with natural makeup and chamomile floral styling. Young woman with {argument name="complexion" default="dewy glass skin"} and subtle natural makeup — soft pink lips, gentle blush, luminous base. Small chamomile flowers woven into {argument name="hair style" default="loosely braided hair"}. Warm afternoon golden hour light creating soft lens flare. Shallow depth of field with creamy bokeh background of wildflower meadow. Slight overexposed dreamy feel. Shot on 85mm f/1.4, medium format aesthetic. Clean, fresh, natural beauty editorial. Soft pastel tones, no harsh shadows.
entries.promptZh: 柔和美妆人像，自然妆容搭配洋甘菊花卉造型。年轻女性拥有【{argument name="complexion" default="水光玻璃肌"}】，搭配淡雅自然妆容——柔粉嘴唇、轻柔腮红、发光底妆。小洋甘菊花朵编入【{argument name="hair style" default="松散编发"}】中。温暖午后黄金时刻光线制造柔和镜头眩光。浅景深搭配奶油感野花草地虚化背景。轻微过曝的梦幻感。85mm f/1.4 拍摄，中画幅美学。清爽自然美妆编辑风格。柔和粉彩色调，无硬阴影。

entries.title: 黑白时尚杂志封面
entries.description: 高对比黑白时尚大片，女性肖像叠加杂志排版，极简留白构图，纽约时尚编辑美学。
entries.prompt: High-contrast black and white fashion magazine cover shoot. Striking female model with defined cheekbones and bold eye makeup, wearing {argument name="outfit" default="architectural structured blazer"}. Clean stark white studio background. Sharp geometric shadows falling across face and body. Typography overlay elements: magazine name at top, bold serif headline, smaller subtext columns on sides — authentic editorial layout. Dramatic directional studio lighting creating strong shadow play. Shot on Hasselblad medium format, 80mm lens. Crisp, high-fashion editorial. Timeless and sophisticated.
entries.promptZh: 高对比度黑白时尚杂志封面拍摄。面部轮廓鲜明、大胆眼妆的女性模特，身穿【{argument name="outfit" default="建筑感结构式西装外套"}】。干净纯白摄影棚背景。几何阴影横跨面部和身体。排版覆层元素：顶部杂志名称、粗体衬线标题、两侧较小副文字栏——真实编辑版式。戏剧性定向摄影棚灯光制造强烈阴影层次。哈苏中画幅拍摄，80mm 镜头。清晰高端时尚编辑风格。永恒而精致。

entries.title: 梦幻水彩风男孩插画
entries.description: 梦幻水彩绘本风格，卷发男孩站在欧洲街角花店前，仙女灯光斑，秋日暖调，手绘素描线条加水彩…
entries.prompt: A fantastical watercolor-style illustration. A {argument name="character" default="cute boy with curly hair"} is standing on a {argument name="location" default="warm European street corner"}. He is wearing an oversized {argument name="clothing" default="pastel green knit sweater"}, loose beige shorts, and holding a coffee cup and a bouquet of wildflowers. His slightly messy ginger-colored hair is adorned with small flowers. Fairy lights glow gently overhead with soft cinematic bokeh. A dreamlike autumn atmosphere. The background features fine details of a flower shop. Large, adorable eyes and slightly rosy cheeks. Hand-drawn sketch-style lines with watercolor bleeds. Warm, natural lighting. Ultra-high-definition picture-book art style. Soft pastel colors. A charming and magical atmosphere.
entries.promptZh: 一幅梦幻般的水彩风格插画。一个【{argument name="character" default="卷发可爱男孩"}】正站在【{argument name="location" default="温馨欧洲街角"}】。他穿着一件超大号的【{argument name="clothing" default="淡绿色针织毛衣"}】，搭配宽松米色短裤，手里拿着咖啡杯和一束野花。他略显凌乱的姜黄色头发上点缀着小花。头顶仙女灯发出柔和光芒，伴随着细腻的电影级光斑。营造出梦幻秋日氛围。背景呈现出花店精致细节。拥有又大又可爱的眼睛和微微泛红的脸颊。手绘素描线条结合水彩晕染效果。温暖自然光。超高清绘本艺术风格。柔和粉彩色调。充满魅力与魔法的氛围。

entries.title: 极简奢华品牌概念大片
entries.description: 奢侈品牌广告的极致克制美学——一件商品、一块空白、几个字母，沉默即是奢华的语言。
entries.prompt:
Create a minimalist luxury brand concept image for MAISON NOIR. The philosophy: restraint is the ultimate luxury. Vast white or off-white negative space dominates—the product or brand element occupies no more than 15–20% of the frame, positioned with mathematical precision.

The product is rendered with jeweler's scrutiny: every surface, texture, and edge visible in perfect clarity. Material: brushed gold. One shadow, clean and directional, falls from a single unseen light source.

Typography: brand name set in 8–10px equivalent weight, maximum tracking, uppercase, somewhere unexpected—bottom right, far left, or vertical along the edge. No tagline. No secondary elements.

Color: pure white, one accent tone (champagne, slate grey, or deep forest), and the product's own material color. Inspired by: Bottega Veneta, Loro Piana, Aesop campaign imagery. The silence of the image communicates more than any text could. Ratio 4:5.
entries.promptZh:
为【[品牌/产品]】创作一张极简奢华品牌概念图。理念：克制是终极奢华。大片白色或米白色负空间主导画面——产品或品牌元素占据不超过15-20%的画框，以数学般的精准定位。

产品以珠宝商的审视标准渲染：每个表面、纹理和边缘在完美清晰度中可见。材质：【[材质：拉丝金/哑光白陶瓷/陈年勃艮第皮革]】。一道阴影，干净而有方向性，从单一不可见光源投下。

字体：品牌名以8-10px等效字重排列，最大字间距，大写，出现在意想不到的位置——右下角、远左侧或沿边缘垂直排列。无标语。无次要元素。

色彩：纯白色、一个强调色调（香槟色、石板灰或深森林绿）和产品本身的材质颜色。灵感来自：Bottega Veneta、Loro Piana、Aesop品牌形象。图像的沉默比任何文字都传达更多。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 冰蓝液态飞溅产品摄影
entries.description: 高速摄影冻结液体飞溅的戏剧瞬间——产品与液体在视觉张力中相遇，每一滴都是一个完美球体。
entries.prompt:
Create a high-speed liquid splash product photograph featuring a cobalt blue glass perfume bottle. The product sits at the center of a dramatic explosion of ice-cold water with frozen droplets, frozen at the peak of impact—an arch of liquid erupting upward and outward, individual droplets suspended as perfect spheres catching studio light.

Background: pure black or deep navy gradient. Product is clearly identifiable and pristine—untouched by the surrounding liquid chaos. The splash forms a natural crown or arch framing the product.

Lighting: multiple rim lights backlighting the liquid to reveal its translucency and refractive quality—each droplet is a tiny lens. One hard key light from front-right creating the main specular highlight on the product. The liquid appears ice-cold: pale cyan-white with blue shadows.

Technical quality: motion frozen as if at 1/25000 second shutter. Every droplet in sharp focus. Commercial advertising photography, ultra-clean, 4K. Square 1:1.
entries.promptZh:
创作一幅以【[产品]】为主角的高速液态飞溅产品摄影。产品坐落在【[液体：冰冷水/蓝色精华/透明矿泉水]】的戏剧性爆发中心——液体在冲击峰值时向上向外爆发，一个个液滴悬停在空中，如完美球体捕捉摄影棚光线。

背景：纯黑色或深海军蓝渐变。产品清晰可辨且完美无瑕——未被周围液体混沌触及。飞溅形成自然的皇冠或拱形将产品框入。

光效：多个轮廓逆光照亮液体，揭示其透明度和折射特质——每个液滴都是一个微型镜头。一道从右前方的硬主光在产品上产生主要高光。液体呈现冰冷感：苍白青白色配蓝色阴影。

技术质量：运动冻结如1/25000秒快门。每个液滴清晰对焦。商业广告摄影，超干净，4K。正方形 1:1。

entries.title: Y2K 动漫街头风模特
entries.description: 2000年前后Y2K千禧美学的重生——亮蓝发色、低腰牛仔裤、蝴蝶发夹和动漫大眼，城市街…
entries.prompt:
Create a Y2K-inspired anime streetwear fashion editorial portrait of a confident girl with butterfly clips and metallic mini skirt. The character channels early 2000s aesthetics reborn: iridescent hair in electric blue or platinum, butterfly hair clips and chunky platform sneakers, low-rise cargo pants with safety pins, a tiny crop top with star and heart motifs, oversized tinted bug-eye sunglasses.

The art style blends anime illustration with fashion photography: bold graphic eyes with holographic reflections, slightly exaggerated proportions, but rendered in a semi-realistic style. Background: Tokyo street corner in 2001—digital kiosk glow, vending machines, scattered Y2K brand signage in chrome and holographic foil.

Color palette: iridescent pastels, chrome silver, electric pink and cyan, holographic rainbow gloss. Slight scanline overlay suggesting CRT monitor aesthetic. Fashion editorial composition, confident pose, direct eye contact. Ratio 2:3.

entries.title: 赛博朋克霓虹城市夜景
entries.description: 酸雨倾盆的2049年深夜——霓虹倒影在积水街道，巨型广告牌汉字在烟雾中闪烁，孤独的剪影…
entries.prompt:
Paint a cinematic cyberpunk cityscape set in 2049 Neo-Tokyo 2077. Torrential acid rain. The streets below reflect an infinite neon mirror: magenta, electric blue, toxic green kanji advertising signs stacked thirty stories high. Steam vents from grated manholes. Crowds in ponchos and face masks move through the narrow alleys.

A lone a lone detective in a worn trench coat stands silhouetted on a rooftop edge, back to camera, overlooking the city's electric abyss. In the sky: massive blimp advertising holograms, drone swarms, and layer upon layer of elevated highways with gridlocked flying vehicles, their brake lights smearing red in the rain.

Art direction: Blade Runner 2049 × Ghost in the Shell × Akira. Color palette: deep indigo black, saturated magenta and cyan neon, orange fire bursts, chromatic aberration. Extreme atmospheric perspective with volumetric light shafts through fog. Ultra-detailed, cinematic widescreen 16:9.
entries.promptZh:

艺术指导：银翼杀手2049 × 攻壳机动队 × 阿基拉。色彩：深靛蓝黑、饱和品红和青色霓虹、橙色火光、色差效果。极致大气透视与雾中体积光束。超细节，电影宽屏 16:9。

entries.prompt:
Create a double exposure portrait of a woman's silhouette merged with ancient pine forest. The human silhouette provides the outer boundary; within it, a secondary landscape scene is visible—trees, water, or cosmos filling the figure as if they are made of nature itself.

Exposure balance: the portrait's facial features should remain subtly readable, while the landscape fills and flows through the form. The background outside the silhouette fades to soft foggy white or deep night blue.

Tone: silver gelatin film aesthetic, high contrast, delicate grain. Key light comes from behind casting the figure as a near-silhouette. The landscape within glows with an internal light—moonlit forest, bioluminescent waves, or star clusters. Color: predominantly monochromatic silver-blue-white with a single warm amber accent. Dreamy, poetic, contemplative. Ratio 2:3.
entries.promptZh:

entries.title: 严格保留身份特征的黄金时刻人像
entries.description: 创建一位身穿运动装、以日落为背景的女性逼真肖像，并严格执行对参考面部特征的还原。
entries.prompt:
一张逼真的年轻女性肖像，她约 22 岁，随意地坐在深色花岗岩台面上，直视镜头，带着轻松而含蓄的微笑。她身穿一套色彩拼接的运动装：一件短袖 T 恤，正面为纯白色，袖子和肩部为亮橙色，搭配同色系橙色短裤，短裤配有白色抽绳和侧边白色条纹。她的右腿抬起，右臂舒适地搭在膝盖上。她拥有自然优雅的女性气质，皮肤健康且富有光泽。

场景位于户外阳台或露台，配有黑色金属栏杆。背景中，迷人的黄金时刻日落照亮了宽阔的河流或湖泊，天空呈现出充满活力的暖橙色和黄色色调，并在水面上形成美丽的倒影，左侧可见郁郁葱葱的绿树。

使用 85mm 镜头拍摄，光圈 f/1.8，电影感黄金时刻布光，浅景深，优美的自然背景虚化，超写实皮肤纹理，柔和的皮肤光泽，真实的面部细节，自然色彩，专业摄影，高分辨率。

严格使用上传的参考图像来生成她的面部和身份特征。保持原始面部 100% 不变并与参考完全一致——相同的面部特征、面部结构、比例、肤色、眼形和颜色、鼻子、嘴唇、眉毛、下颌线、发型、发质、年龄和自然表情。不要美化、改变、重塑或理想化面部。保留参考图像中完全相同的身份和发型。最终图像必须看起来像是参考照片中的同一个女孩，只是置于这个新场景和服装中。

皮肤应具有自然健康的光泽，同时保持真实的皮肤纹理和毛孔。无面部扭曲，无身份改变，无人工美颜滤镜，无过度化妆，无面部修改。

entries.title: 秋季咖啡馆星冰乐提示词
entries.description: 适用于 Nano Banana 的秋季咖啡馆人像详细提示词，包含彼岸花和玩具贵宾犬元素。
entries.prompt:
面部/发型：严格遵循附带的面部照片。不得改变五官特征、比例、发型或身体比例。不得去个性化。
发质状态：干燥，自然状态。发丝流动自然。
表情：双眼微眯，视线向右上方看。自然的张嘴微笑。眉毛形态自然。情绪愉悦明亮。

上衣：严格遵循附带的服装照片。
下装：严格遵循附带的服装照片。
鞋履：严格遵循附带的服装照片。
衣物状态：无凌乱，干燥且穿着整齐。

配饰：佩戴带有小心形图案的银色项链，每只耳朵佩戴一枚小耳钉。双手捧着一杯白色 Frappuccino（星冰乐）。脚边有一只可爱的玩具贵宾犬。

姿势：深深坐在藤椅上。右脚踝交叉在左脚上。腰部朝向镜头，肩膀略微偏右。上半身轻微后仰。从头部到腰部的轴线相对于垂直方向向右倾斜 5 度。脸部看向右上方。右肘轻微弯曲，将 Frappuccino 持于胸前。左臂沿身体自然下垂。双腿伸直并拢。

前景：将最近的蓝色花束替换为一簇红色彼岸花，而非鲜艳的蓝紫色花朵。占据屏幕约 15% 的面积。前景中的彼岸花大部分呈现柔和虚化效果，红色作为视觉点缀。焦点集中在前景的彼岸花和脚边的玩具贵宾犬上。

背景：完全移除城堡，改为具有秋意的景观。远处是金黄色的芒草，再往后是开始变红/橙/黄的树木。如同蓝天下的秋日高地/花园般富有纵深感的景观。背景强烈虚化，秋色柔和交融。展现从夏季到秋季的季节过渡感。

构图：包含膝盖以下的竖幅人像。头顶距离画面顶部边缘约 10%，脚部在底部边缘被截断。人物位于中心略偏左的位置。相机角度从主体腰部高度略微仰拍。标准镜头的自然视野。通过重度虚化前景的红色彼岸话来强调景深。

地点：户外露台座位。初秋的晴朗午后。木质咖啡馆的屋檐下。清澈的蓝天伴有稀疏的白云。远处有金黄色的芒草和变色的树木。夏日的明亮与秋日的氛围共存，充满清新的季节感。

光线：来自上方的自然阳光。色温略微偏暖。高调明亮，中等对比度。自然的轮廓光勾勒出头发/肩膀的线条。右上方有柔和的阳光和微弱的光晕。无高光溢出。

摄影风格：写实风格的户外人像照片。距离主体约 2 米，相当于 50mm 焦距。浅景深。细腻的胶片颗粒感。高饱和度但色彩自然。印象派式地表现红色彼岸花、金黄色芒草和蓝天之间的色彩对比。空气通透。

质感：光滑自然的皮肤。无汗水/湿润感。浅景深。中性白平衡。无过度美颜滤镜。

风格：照片级真实感。一张令人印象深刻的清新照片，一眼即可传达季节感，适合 SNS 分享。

比例：竖屏 9:16 / 1080x1920px

entries.title: 历史大厅中的奢华肚皮舞者编辑照

entries.prompt:
创建一个逼真的奢华时尚大片，展示一位成年专业肚皮舞者在宏伟的历史地中海或中东石厅中。保持文化基础的可识别性和精致性，而不是幻想、戏剧性的角色扮演或服装选美风格。

她穿着精心制作的深酒红色舞蹈套装，配有结构化的刺绣上衣和高腰合身的臀部线条，流入一条长而流畅的裙子。密集的古董金丝细工、精细珠饰、小硬币和克制的金属刺绣集中在领口、腰部及臀部周围，在裙摆处逐渐变轻。添加多层金项链、雕塑感手镯、耳环和精致的脚链。服装应看起来昂贵、手工制作、安全且专为真实运动设计，而非过度装饰。

捕捉她在动作之间的瞬间，而不是教科书式的姿势。她的臀部几乎正对相机，而肋骨略微转向一侧，通过腰部形成强烈的螺旋效果。重量落在一条腿上，另一侧臀部向前释放。一只手臂向相机延伸，手指放松且有表现力，另一只手臂在她头部旁边升起。长而深色有质感的头发，穿插着几缕微妙的辫子和微小的金属细节，带着残余的运动环绕在她的肩膀上。

从略低于腰部的高度拍摄，足够近以让她的主导地位显现，同时保留全身和建筑规模。她目光越过镜头，带着专注、自信的力度。

高大的雕刻拱门和风化的石柱在她身后退入温暖的阴影中。几个远处的坐着的人物仅作为柔和的剪影出现，暗示一场私人表演而不成为主体。金色的午后光线从一侧进入，掠过她的皮肤、刺绣、珠宝和移动的面料，而她身后的厅堂逐渐变暗。保留毛孔、细发、面料重量、真实的金属反射、轻微的汗水、自然的解剖结构和克制的电影颗粒感。

最终图像应感觉像是一位知名时尚摄影师记录了一位强大的舞者在真实的历史空间中：文化根基深厚、性感、威严、触觉丰富且无疑是编辑风格的。没有幻想主题、舞台布景、通用的后宫风格、过多的装饰、塑料般的皮肤、CGI 抛光、标志、文字或水印。

entries.description: 使用 Nano Banana 为产品创建专业广告参考表的详细提示词和工作流。
entries.prompt:
分析产品并创建一个高分辨率、照片级真实感的专业广告参考表，包含以下四个部分，背景为干净的白色/中性摄影棚背景，采用高端商业产品摄影风格，柔和可控的灯光，逼真的材质，清晰的细节，微妙的阴影以及专业的编辑网格布局。

3. 产品特写 - 标志/标签、纹理/材质、关键组件、包装细节以及其他重要的识别特征。

  - 底部放置日文描述“{step3Desc}”。

[质量与字体规范]
- 简洁、干净的 2D 插画，扁平化设计，线条清晰明快。
- 所有文字必须准确绘制为可读的日文字体（哥特体），不得出现拼写错误。
- 排除所有 3D 效果、阴影、笔记本电脑样机背景或相机倾斜；在整个屏幕上显示扁平图表本身。

- 长宽比：--ar 16:9

entries.title: 区域文化图谱海报
entries.description: 一个高级提示词，用于创建结构化的 2x2 网格海报，通过食物和工艺品对比区域文化美学。
entries.prompt:
2x2 网格，16:9，针对南半球 4 种被低估的早餐执行此操作：INPUT = [{argument name="category" default="主题类别"} / {argument name="region" default="区域集合"} / {argument name="criteria" default="筛选标准"} / {argument name="mood" default="氛围"}]
MODE = no_hardcoding / inference_only

运行 REGIONAL_CULTURAL_ATLAS_EXTRACTION：

CATEGORY_DNA := 推断正在比较的事物类型、其用途、重要性以及使其在视觉上具有辨识度的特征

REGION_DNA[each] := 推断当地环境、视觉文化、色调、排版风格、纹理、符号、景观、工具、仪式和社会背景

ITEM_SELECTION[each] := 推断一个符合“主题类别” + “区域” + “筛选标准”的被忽视或具有代表性的项目

HERO_VISUAL[each] := 推断最佳视觉处理方式：
摆盘食物、产品特写、仪式场景、工具布局、服饰肖像、静物摄影、以景观为背景的工艺品、以地图为背景的图表或符号化小插图

COPY_SYSTEM[each] := 生成：
- 大号项目标题
- 简短的情感标语
- 产地/位置标签
- 2–4 个微型描述符
- 印章或徽章短语
- 小段背景说明

GRAPHIC_SYSTEM := 推断撕纸效果、印刷网格、柔和色块、地形线、印章、边框、半色调、图谱标记和编辑排版间距

渲染：
一张高级区域对比海报，其中每个面板都具有独特的地域感，但又统一于同一个文化主题。

禁止：
硬编码的南半球、固定的早餐、固定的食物、固定的国家、固定的米色/红色/绿色调色板、虚假的当地事实、随意的旅游海报陈词滥调。

entries.title: 错综复杂的龙之奇幻诗篇
entries.description: 这是一首错综复杂的抽象艺术诗，描述了一条跨越时空的永恒之龙，用于生成测试的电影级空间与…
entries.prompt:
双岸记忆之翼

龙不选择世纪。
是世纪在选择自身，
穿过由拖延与余晖构成的躯体。
一翼拖曳着图书馆最后一页未被焚毁的纸张，
那是在纸张学会自己的名字之前就已陨落的文明。
另一翼梳理着全息雨幕，
来自那些尚未决定
是屹立不倒还是化为传闻的高塔。
在双翼之间，空气保留着两份历法，
却忘记了哪一份正在运行。
它的鳞片比“鳞”这个词本身更为古老。
它们记得那些尚未点燃的
熔炉的炽热，
以及在某种叙述中
早已熄灭的
星辰的寒冷。
符文如同一座城市尚未获得思考资格的念头，
浮现又沉没。
每一次光脉冲既是遗迹也是原型。
下方，街道湿润，承载着已然发生之事
以及仍在协商抵达之事。
霓虹灯在曾是冰川耐心的水面上书写，
而后来，那只会成为关于干渴的传闻。
地基坐落在森林的静谧之上，
森林仍梦见自己依然挺立。
广告牌宣传着明天，
却已对尚未到来的黄昏感到思乡。
这生物的双眼承载着唯一诚实的天气：
一只眼是记忆的翠绿，
尚不知晓自己已然终结；
另一只眼是疑问的湛蓝，
尚未找到将要问出它的那张嘴。
它们注视我们，如同时间在无人窥视时
注视着自身——
没有怜悯，没有判决，
只有长久的、礼貌的凝视。
我们生活在它掠过时短暂的气流中，
那奇特而仁慈的间隙，
过去尚未与我们了结，
而未来已开始
怀念我们尚未失去的一切。
除了转动，别无承诺：
那缓慢而明亮的翅膀铰链，
同时属于每一个时刻，
却又不完全属于其中任何一个。
它留下的薄雾既非终结，也非开端。
那是它们在下一个不确定性
张开安静而必要的手掌之前，
短暂相认的地方。

标题：
高端枫糖浆产品商业广告项目

格式：
• 单页高端项目
• 3:4 竖屏比例
• 高端食品广告
• 8 个电影级产品特写镜头
• 产品始终作为核心主角
• 高端广告代理商演示风格

页眉：
• 优雅的衬线字体
• 信息卡片：
  - 时长：{argument name="duration" default="20 秒"}
  - 风格：电影级美食商业广告
  - 产品：{argument name="product name" default="纯枫糖浆"}
  - 音频：缓慢倾倒声 + 轻柔食物 ASMR
• “为何这种风格有效”板块
• {argument name="color aesthetic" default="温暖琥珀色、奶油色和深棕色"} 美学
• 极简枫叶装饰元素

项目：
1. 高端枫糖浆瓶矗立在抛光的深色木桌上

4. 糖浆在半空中形成光亮的丝带状
5. 糖浆倾泻在松软的煎饼上
6. 展示浓郁糖浆质感与微小反光的极致微距
7. 煎饼塔与主角瓶身及枫叶环绕
8. 伴随戏剧性糖浆倾倒的最终高端产品定格画面

每个分镜：
• 场景编号
• 时长标签
• 运镜方向
• 视觉画面
• 动作描述
• 产品细节

摄影：
极致微距、慢动作液体摄影、俯拍美食视角、受控推拉镜头、浅景深、电影级主角构图。

风格：
超写实食品广告、逼真的糖浆粘稠度、光泽金色质感、温暖影棚灯光、高端玻璃包装、精致美食呈现、8K 分辨率。

entries.title: 电影感编辑风格卧室人像
entries.description: 用于创建女性奢华卧室超写实电影编辑摄影的提示词，包含特定身份锁定指令。
entries.prompt:
创作一张超写实的电影感编辑风格照片，画面中同一位女性优雅地坐在奢华经典卧室里一张精致复古床旁的地板上。她留着自然微卷的深棕色长发，身穿一件剪裁考究的无袖象牙白缎面连衣裙，腰部修身，裙摆飘逸，搭配透明白色长筒袜和优雅的白色尖头高跟鞋。

她自然地坐着，双腿伸展在抛光的深色人字纹木地板上，一只手轻放在膝盖附近，另一只手支撑在身侧。身后是一张华丽的黑色锻铁床，铺着奶油色花卉图案床品，叠放着精致的枕头，配有优雅的米色窗帘、经典的护墙板墙壁以及温暖的中性色调。

在她身旁放着一本打开的复古书籍，上面搁着一朵奶油色的玫瑰，旁边是一套精致的白色瓷茶杯和茶托。柔和温暖的日光从右侧窗户射入，营造出逼真的高光和细腻的阴影。

构图：全身肖像，从头到脚清晰可见的女性，优雅自然的姿势，平视相机视角，50mm 镜头，f/2.8 光圈，浅景深，电影感奢华时尚编辑摄影，真实的皮肤毛孔，根根分明的发丝，细致的面料纹理，物理准确的光照，自然的解剖结构，逼真的比例，微妙的暖色调分级，8K 照片级真实感。

身份锁定：全程保持相同的参考面部特征，精确的面部结构，精确的眼睛及眼距，精确的鼻子，精确的嘴唇，精确的下颌线，精确的肤色，无身份漂移，无面部改变，无面部美化，无面部融合。

负面提示词：
不同的脸，改变的身份，换脸，身份漂移，不同的面部特征，改变的眼型，改变的鼻子，改变的嘴唇，改变的下颌线，面部扭曲，塑料皮肤，过度平滑的皮肤，CGI，3D 渲染，卡通，动漫，不真实的解剖结构，多余的手指，畸形的手，多余的肢体，重复的身体部位，扭曲的腿，模糊的脸，低细节，刺眼的光线，过饱和的颜色，文字，标志，水印。

entries.title: 雨中车站全身肖像
entries.description: 为 Nano Banana Pro 设计的提示词，用于生成一位女性在暴雨中等待火车站的…

严格保留其参考面部特征和身份。她以平静、优雅的神情自然地看向镜头。

透过大型车站窗户可见倾盆大雨，背景中有湿滑的铁轨、水洼、雾气、倒影以及一列正在驶来的火车。呈现高端豪华的车站建筑风格，配以温暖的金色灯光和抛光大理石地面。

质量：4K UHD，照片级实拍质感，HDR，真实皮肤毛孔，自然发丝，电影级布光，高级色彩分级，细微胶片颗粒感。

负面提示词：截断的脚部，截断的鞋子，截断的行李箱，过大的雨伞，扭曲的手部，多余的手指，面部漂移，不同身份，塑料皮肤，卡通，动漫，CGI，3D 渲染，不真实的雨水，模糊的面部，低分辨率，不必要的文字，多余的标志，水印。
